3.mechanic: Blood 3: The Veil affects only 1 mortal instead of 3. The charm is still effective but costs 1 Humanity if used — desperation makes the act uglier and you know it.
3.narrative: You are performing now rather than projecting. The audience can tell, even if they cannot articulate what feels wrong.

7.mechanic: Blood 7: The Veil extends to 60 feet and the charm lasts until the end of the next scene. Charmed mortals will not make the Wisdom save to notice manipulation unless directly confronted with evidence.
7.narrative: The room rearranges itself around you when you arrive. Not literally — but eyes follow, voices quiet, the best seat opens up, and everyone present becomes faintly certain that whatever you want is a reasonable thing to want.

decreases.trigger: Activate The Crimson Veil
Use the Veil to lure a mortal into a situation where they are harmed
Use the Veil to lure a mortal into feeding

development_paths.name: The Weight of Glamour
development_paths.requirement: Use The Crimson Veil in 4 separate social scenes. At least 1 must end with the charmed mortal genuinely better off than when they entered.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The First Hunt'. Unlocks path to 'Shroud of Night' (tier 2 lateral B).

hooks.text: Someone who was under the Veil has written about you. Not an accusation — a love letter of sorts, published in a small private journal, passed between a particular social set. They have described you in detail: your stillness, your gaze, the way the room changed when you entered. The journal has reached someone who recognizes the description as a symptom rather than a compliment. They have sent you a card. The card says only: I would very much like to meet.

A rival has begun working the same social territory you have been cultivating. They are not a vampire — but they are something, and their charm has a different texture to yours, older and less careful. Their presence is unraveling the network of small loyalties you have built. Three of your regular contacts have canceled meetings in the past week. One of them has a bruise on their wrist they are covering with their sleeve.

vampirism_powers.name: Trial: The First Hunt
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: The trial does not announce itself. You simply realize one night that you have been circling the same problem for too long — and that the only way through it is to hunt something that does not want to be caught, for a reason that has nothing to do with feeding.

effects.mechanic: A three-phase hunt through a social or urban environment. Phase 1: Identify the quarry — Insight DC 14 to read the target's patterns and vulnerabilities. Phase 2: Move unseen — Stealth or Persuasion DC 13 (choose method) to close the distance without triggering alarm. Phase 3: The moment — Charisma DC 15 to execute the plan at the moment of maximum vulnerability. Succeed on 2 of 3 to complete the trial. Fail all 3: the quarry escapes and one NPC in your social network becomes aware you were hunting. That awareness costs you.
effects.narrative: This is not a fight. Fights are simple — they begin and end and the body knows what to do during them. This is the other thing, the part that distinguishes the dead from the undead: the patience, the reading of a room, the understanding that the most dangerous moment in any hunt is the one just before the prey realizes it is prey.

skill_checks.success: You map the quarry's patterns precisely. Gain advantage on the Phase 2 check.
skill_checks.failure: You misread a key behavior. The Phase 2 check is made at disadvantage.

skill_checks.success: You are exactly where you need to be. The quarry does not know.
skill_checks.failure: The quarry senses something — not you, specifically, but a wrongness in the air. Phase 3 DC increases by 3.

skill_checks.success: The plan executes perfectly. The trial is complete. The quarry never knew they were being hunted.
skill_checks.failure: The moment passes. The quarry is gone. Begin again next night.

vampirism_powers.name: Blood Sorcery
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete The First Hunt and return to your haven with blood still on your hands — metaphorically or literally. The power does not arrive. It surfaces, like something that was already there, waiting for you to be ready.

effects.mechanic: You may spend 2 Blood to perform one of three blood-workings per scene: (1) Boil — a creature within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Constitution save or take 2d6 necrotic damage and be poisoned until end of their next turn. (2) Still — a creature within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom save or be paralyzed for 1 round. (3) Call — a creature who has given you blood willingly within the past month must make a DC 12 Wisdom save or be compelled to move toward you for 1 round.
effects.narrative: Blood is the medium and the message. When you reach through the air and touch it — the blood still moving in a living body — you feel the shape of the person it belongs to. Their fear. Their anger. Their small daily pain. You could choose to care about this. Most nights you do not. The working is imprecise and intimate and entirely without mercy, which is, you are learning, a reasonable description of what you are becoming.

0.mechanic: Blood Sorcery unavailable at Blood 0.
0.narrative: No blood to spend. The workings go dark. You are just a body in the room.

3.mechanic: Blood 3: only the Boil working is available. The subtler workings require more than you have to give.
3.narrative: Pain is the coarsest instrument. When you are running low, pain is what remains.

7.mechanic: Blood 7: all three workings cost 1 Blood instead of 2. Additionally, the Humanity save DCs increase by 2 — you can feel how to hurt them more precisely, and precision costs.
7.narrative: Full-fed the workings are surgical. You could stop a heart. You haven't. You are noting that the option exists.

decreases.trigger: Activate any blood working
Use Boil or Still against a mortal who posed no lethal threat
Use Call to compel a mortal who has trusted you

development_paths.name: The Crimson Art
development_paths.requirement: Use all three blood workings at least twice each across separate scenes. In at least one use of Call, allow the compelled mortal to leave unharmed afterward.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Long Night'.

hooks.text: A physician has noticed that three patients in the district share a set of inexplicable symptoms — internal bruising, sudden episodes of paralysis lasting seconds, a specific kind of migraine that begins behind the left eye. He has written a paper. The paper has not been published yet. He showed it to one colleague. That colleague has forwarded it to someone else entirely.

Another vampire — older, with the particular stillness of something that has had centuries to stop fidgeting — has sent a message requesting a meeting on neutral ground. The message is polite and precise and says almost nothing. What it does say, in the last line, is this: I know what you did with the blood. I have not decided yet whether it was impressive or alarming. Come and tell me which it was.

vampirism_powers.name: Lord of Minds
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete The First Hunt via the path of Pale Dominion — the hunt must be completed without violence, through dominion and positioning alone.

effects.mechanic: Pale Dominion evolves. You may now issue complex, multi-step instructions (still not against core survival instincts). Additionally, once per long rest: you may plant a false memory in a mortal (Charisma vs. Wisdom DC 15). The memory is convincing but not perfect — on a critical success, it is seamless. Costs 3 Blood.
effects.narrative: The mind is a house and you have learned where the locks are. Slipping through them has stopped feeling like trespass. This is the thing that should worry you, and sometimes does, in the small hours before you go still for the day — not what you have done to the people inside the house, but how comfortable you have become with the entry.

0.mechanic: Lord of Minds unavailable at Blood 0.
0.narrative: The hunger eats the subtlety first.

3.mechanic: Blood 3: false memory costs 4 Blood and the DC increases to 17. The planting is imprecise — the target may notice seams in the memory later.
3.narrative: The craft suffers when you are diminished. The memories come out blurred at the edges. Sometimes they crack.

7.mechanic: Blood 7: false memory DC drops to 13, and on success the target cannot question the memory under any normal circumstance — only magical compulsion to truthfulness reveals it. Additionally, Dominion now persists for 24 hours without renewal.
7.narrative: Full-fed the architecture is flawless. You build the room and they live in it and never look for the door because as far as they are concerned there was never a door.

decreases.trigger: Plant a false memory
Maintain a complex Dominion instruction beyond 1 scene
decreases.note: Per additional scene sustained.

decreases.trigger: Plant a false memory that causes the target lasting harm or grief
Erase a genuine memory that the target valued

development_paths.name: The House of Forgetting
development_paths.requirement: Plant false memories in 3 separate mortals. At least 1 memory must be pleasant — something you gave them rather than took.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Long Night'.

hooks.text: A mortal you rewrote has started dreaming incorrectly. The false memory holds perfectly during waking hours — but in sleep the seams show, and they are writing the dreams down. The journal is filling up with half-right details that, assembled, would tell a person exactly what you are and what you did. They have started showing the journal to their sister.

An old vampire — not your sire, but old enough to have known your sire's sire — has been watching your work with minds from a careful distance. They do not disapprove. They are collecting something, though you cannot yet tell what. They have left a name for you to find: a mortal who has been rewritten before, by someone other than you, and who is now showing signs that the previous work is unraveling. They want to know what happens when the architecture collapses. They want you to be there when it does.

vampirism_powers.name: Shroud of Night
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete The First Hunt via the path of The Crimson Veil — the hunt must be completed without the quarry ever perceiving you as a threat.

effects.mechanic: You may spend 2 Blood to step into shadow for up to 1 minute. While shrouded: you are invisible in dim light or darkness, you move silently regardless of surface, and you may pass through a crowd without being registered by memory (mortals who saw you cannot describe you afterward). In bright light, you are merely heavily obscured. Costs 2 Blood to activate.
effects.narrative: The dark is not hiding you. You are simply becoming more of what you already are — something that the light was always slightly wrong about. When you step out of it again, back into the lit world, you feel the edges of yourself reassemble. The process is neither pleasant nor unpleasant. It is simply accurate.

0.mechanic: Shroud unavailable at Blood 0.
0.narrative: Nothing left to spend. You stand in the light like everything else.

3.mechanic: Blood 3: Shroud lasts only 2 rounds and does not suppress memory of your presence — mortals who saw you retain a blurred impression.
3.narrative: Brief and imperfect. You surface from the dark already half-visible.

7.mechanic: Blood 7: Shroud extends to 10 minutes. Additionally, once per long rest you may use Shroud in full daylight — bright light no longer limits it. The cost increases to 3 Blood for this extended use.
7.narrative: Full-fed you can take the dark with you into places the dark does not naturally go. People look through you on a bright street. The sun does not touch you — not because it cannot, but because something about the fullness of the blood makes you briefly, perfectly, absent.

decreases.trigger: Activate Shroud of Night
Use Shroud to observe a mortal intimately without their knowledge on 3 or more occasions
decreases.note: Not for any gain — simply because you can and they do not know.

development_paths.name: The Patient Dark
development_paths.requirement: Use Shroud of Night in 4 separate scenes. In at least 2, choose to leave without acting despite having the opportunity.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Long Night'.

hooks.text: A child in the district has been telling people there is a shadow that walks. Not in the way children tell stories — with conviction, with specific details, with a description of the precise corner of the street where they have seen it three times now. The child's parents have dismissed it. A priest has not.

Something else uses the dark in this city. You have felt it twice now — a texture in the shadow that is not yours, a movement that was not you. It is not a vampire. It is aware of you. Last night it left something at the edge of the shadow you were using: a small object, personal, that you lost three months ago and did not notice was gone. It knows where you sleep.

vampirism_powers.name: Trial: The Long Night
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: The Long Night is not assigned. It happens when the accumulated weight of what you have done and what you have refused to do reaches a point the blood recognizes. You will know it has begun when you wake one evening and cannot remember the face of someone you loved before the Embrace. Not their name — the face. The forgetting is the first movement.

effects.mechanic: A four-movement ordeal conducted over four consecutive in-game nights with no long rest between them. Movement 1: The Forgetting — voluntarily allow your Humanity to drop by 1 and make a DC 16 Charisma save to hold what remains. Movement 2: The Accounting — name every mortal you have fed from without consent. Not as a list — describe one in full. No check, but this must be done. Movement 3: The Hunger Unbound — spend one full in-game night refusing to feed while Blood sits at 3 or below. DC 15 Wisdom save at the end of the night. Movement 4: The Choice of Name — declare what you are calling yourself now. Not your mortal name. Not what you were. What you have decided to be. This declaration is permanent.
effects.narrative: Four nights to strip everything that was borrowed and decide what is actually yours. The trial does not offer a reward. It offers clarity, which is either the same thing or worse, depending on what the clarity reveals.

skill_checks.success: Hold what remains of yourself through the forgetting. Proceed with Humanity reduced by 1.
skill_checks.failure: Humanity drops by 2 instead. The trial continues. The Long Night does not release you for failing — it simply makes the remaining movements heavier.

skill_checks.success: You hold through the hunger. The dawn finds you diminished but present. The trial is complete.
skill_checks.failure: You break and feed. Humanity drops by 1. The trial resets to Movement 1. Blood and Humanity costs accumulated across the failed attempt carry forward.

vampirism_powers.name: The Red Throne
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete The Long Night having already mastered Blood Sorcery and at least one lateral tier 2 power. The Throne is not a place. It is a posture — the moment you stop moving through the world as a thing that hopes not to be noticed and begin moving through it as a thing that decides what gets noticed.

effects.mechanic: You establish a Court — a network of up to 6 mortal contacts who are bound to you (willing or through Dominion). Once per long rest, you may call on the Court to perform one significant service (gather information, create a distraction, secure a location, intercept a communication). Additionally, your presence in a social scene causes all non-vampiric supernatural effects to require a DC 14 check to affect you — other entities find your particular gravity difficult to work against.
effects.narrative: The Court is not loyalty. Loyalty implies choice, and most of them did not entirely choose. What they have is attachment — the deep, wordless pull of something that has been close to their blood and decided to keep them. You tell yourself this is protection. Some nights it even is.

0.mechanic: Court members feel the absence of your attention physically. Each scene you go without feeding, one Court member makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or seeks you out regardless of instruction.
0.narrative: The connection frays when the blood runs low. They feel it before you do.

4.mechanic: Blood 4: Court capacity increases to 10. Services can now be complex multi-day operations. However, each Court member is now visibly marked — not physically, but behaviorally. Close observers notice the particular deference. DC 13 Insight to identify the pattern.
4.narrative: The court has weight now. People can see it, if they know to look — the way a room adjusts when you enter, the small movements of others to clear your path. You have stopped being a person with connections and started being a center of gravity.

8.mechanic: Blood 8 (full): the Court acts on your behalf without instruction when you are threatened — they do not know why, but they move toward your defense instinctively. This cannot be controlled or prevented. DC 15 Wisdom save for each Court member not to act when you are in visible danger.
8.narrative: You did not mean to build a cult. You built a court and it became a cult because that is the direction the blood pulls things. They would die for you. Three of them would do so happily. You are not comfortable with this. You have also stopped doing much to prevent it.

decreases.trigger: Maintain Court bonds across a long rest
decreases.note: The connection costs. Presence always costs.

decreases.trigger: Allow a Court member to be seriously harmed in your service without intervening when intervention was possible
Use Court members against each other deliberately

increases.trigger: Release a Court member fully — sever the bond, restore any Dominion, and ensure their safety with no benefit to yourself

development_paths.name: The Crown Below the Crown
development_paths.requirement: Maintain a Court of at least 4 members for 14 in-game days. During that time, use the Court to protect someone outside the Court on at least 2 occasions.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Final Draught'.

hooks.text: An older vampire has taken notice of your Court and sent a representative — not a threat, a compliment, which is somehow worse. The older vampire collects things. Courts. Bloodlines. Names. The representative offers you a place within a larger structure, with a title and a territory and obligations that were not explained in full, which is always how the obligations that matter are delivered.

One of your Court members has been taken — not killed, taken, which means someone wants something and chose this specific lever to apply pressure. The message they left is addressed to your vampiric name, the one you chose at the end of The Long Night. They knew that name. They should not have known that name.

vampirism_powers.name: The Dying Light
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete The Long Night having walked primarily the path of subtlety — Lord of Minds or Shroud of Night must be mastered. The Dying Light is what happens to the self when it has spent long enough moving through the world at angles, watching without being seen, deciding without being known.

effects.mechanic: Once per long rest, you may enter a state of Dissolution lasting up to 10 minutes. While dissolved: you are completely invisible and silent, you pass through any gap a mist could pass through, and you cannot interact with the physical world — but you can perceive it perfectly within 60 feet, including through walls. Costs 4 Blood. While dissolved, Blood decreases by 1 per minute. Ending Dissolution is a free action but requires a DC 12 Wisdom save — the longer you are dissolved, the harder it is to want to come back.
effects.narrative: This is the thing the Shroud was pointing toward. Not hiding, not moving through shadows — actual dissolution, the self thinned to the point where walls are a suggestion and presence is a choice. You come back from it correctly, every time so far, but you notice that correctly is doing more work in that sentence than it used to.

0.mechanic: Dissolution unavailable at Blood 0.
0.narrative: Nothing left to spend on becoming nothing.

4.mechanic: Blood 4: Dissolution lasts up to 5 minutes only. The Wisdom save DC to return increases to 14.
4.narrative: Running low, the dissolution pulls harder. Less of you to anchor to.

8.mechanic: Blood 8: Dissolution costs 3 Blood instead of 4, and the Wisdom save DC to return drops to 10. Additionally, once per long rest you may make a physical strike from within Dissolution before it ends — as though condensing briefly into solid form. The strike automatically crits if the target is unaware.
8.narrative: Full-fed the dissolution is comfortable. The Wisdom save is almost performative. You come back because you choose to. The choice is still yours. You check, some nights, by asking whether you want to. The answer has been yes. So far.

decreases.trigger: Activate Dissolution
Each minute sustained in Dissolution
Fail the Wisdom save to return from Dissolution and remain dissolved for an additional scene
Use the dissolved state to observe something private with no intent but observation
decreases.note: The act of pure watching, with no purpose but the watching.

development_paths.name: The Weight of Return
development_paths.requirement: Use Dissolution 5 times. In at least 3, make the Wisdom save to return before the maximum duration expires. In at least 1, stay until the last possible moment and succeed anyway.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Final Draught'.

hooks.text: You spent too long dissolved in a particular room — a library, a private office, somewhere with enough weight of human thought that it left a residue. You brought something back. Not a person, not a thing — a voice, very faint, that does not belong to you and knows your name. It speaks infrequently and says nothing threatening. It says accurate things about people you have not met yet.

Someone has hired a churchman-inquisitor to investigate what they are calling hauntings — rooms that feel watched, doors found open, objects moved. The inquisitor is methodical and has several tools that respond to your particular condition. He has narrowed the incidents to three buildings. You were in all three. He has not found you yet, but he has found the shape of the absence you leave behind, and he is building a frame around it.

vampirism_powers.name: Trial: The Final Draught
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: The Final Draught comes when you have been everything the blood asked you to be and still have not answered the oldest question: not what you are, but whether you chose it. A mortal you have known since before the Embrace finds you. They recognize you. They are old now, or they should not know what you are, or they have something you gave them to keep — a letter, a name, a promise you made when you still believed you would not survive the first year. They hand it back. Then they wait.

effects.mechanic: A single ordeal in three movements with no rest between. Movement 1: The Reckoning — review your Humanity score. For each point below 8, name one thing you did to lose it. This cannot be skipped. If Humanity is 8, name one thing you kept. Movement 2: The Offer — the mortal offers you their blood willingly, enough to fully restore your Blood Meter and raise Humanity by 1. You may accept or refuse. Both have consequences. Movement 3: The Answer — declare whether you accept what you are, reject it, or have not yet decided. Only Accept and Reject unlock tier 4. 'Not yet decided' ends the trial without completion — it can be reattempted, but the mortal will not be there.
effects.narrative: The Final Draught is not a test of power. The power is already there. It is a test of the story you are willing to tell about what you have done with it — to yourself, aloud, in front of someone who knew you when the story was different.

skill_checks.success: Name what was lost or kept. Proceed.
skill_checks.failure: Refusing the Reckoning ends the trial. The mortal leaves. The trial cannot be reattempted this season.

skill_checks.success: Accept: Blood restored, Humanity +1, proceed. Refuse: Blood unchanged, Humanity +1 (the refusal is an act of will), proceed.
skill_checks.failure: N/A — this movement cannot be failed, only skipped. Skipping ends the trial.

vampirism_powers.name: The Eternal
vampirism_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete The Final Draught having mastered both tier 3 powers and answered the question in Movement 3. The answer does not matter. The answering does.

accept.label: Accept what you are.
accept.consequence: Unlock The Eternal in its ascendant form. The vampirism tree is complete. Your Blood Meter ceiling increases by 3. You cannot regain Humanity above your current score through normal means — it is fixed, the watermark of what you chose to be and what it cost. It can still decrease. It will not increase unless something extraordinary occurs.
accept.permanent_effect: Blood ceiling +3. Humanity fixed at current level. All vampiric powers gain the enhancement listed in 'effects'. The choice is on the character sheet permanently under the heading: What I Accepted.

reject.label: Reject what you are — not deny, reject. Consciously, deliberately, at cost.
reject.consequence: The vampirism tree closes. All existing powers remain and cannot be removed. Humanity begins slowly recovering — 1 point per significant in-game month, to a maximum of 7. You gain a singular permanent power: 'The Last Mortal Thought' — once per long rest, you may act as though you were fully human for 1 round: social checks remove vampiric penalties, Humanity checks use a score of 9 regardless of actual score, and you cannot use any vampiric power. The round costs 2 Blood and ends with a DC 13 Wisdom save — on failure, you feed from the nearest mortal regardless of intent.
reject.permanent_effect: Vampirism powers locked. Humanity recovering. 'The Last Mortal Thought' added permanently. The choice is on the character sheet under the heading: What I Refused.

effects.mechanic: All vampiric powers are enhanced: Blood costs reduced by 1 across all powers (minimum 0), Humanity loss triggers require an additional point of severity to activate (minor acts no longer cost Humanity — only significant ones do). Once per long rest, enter The Stillness — a state of perfect predatory calm lasting 1 minute in which: you cannot be surprised, all your vampiric power DCs increase by 2, and any mortal who looks directly at you must make a DC 18 Wisdom save or be paralyzed with awe for 1 round. While in The Stillness, Blood does not decrease from power use.
effects.narrative: The Eternal is not immortality — you have had that since the first night. The Eternal is the moment you stop measuring yourself against what you were and begin measuring the world against what you are. You move through it differently now. Not faster or stronger, though you are both — differently, the way old things move, with the specific gravity of something that has decided what it is and is no longer in a hurry to prove it.

0.mechanic: Blood 0: The Stillness unavailable. All powers go dark. DC 17 Wisdom save each round or attack the nearest living creature. The Eternal at Blood 0 is not a vampire. It is a hunger wearing a familiar shape.
0.narrative: This is what you are without the blood to hold you together. Remember it. Remember it every time you consider letting the reserves run low.

4.mechanic: Blood 4: The Stillness lasts 2 minutes. After it ends, Blood drops by 2 regardless of use during the state — the calm was borrowed against future cost.
4.narrative: Diminished and still formidable. The Stillness holds even when the blood doesn't, for a while. The cost comes later. It always comes later.

8.mechanic: Blood 8 (ceiling): The Stillness can be activated as a reaction, not just an action. The DC 18 awe save becomes DC 20. Additionally, while at Blood ceiling, once per session you may declare that a vampiric power succeeds automatically — no roll, no cost, no check. The blood simply does what you tell it to.
8.narrative: Full to the ceiling and the world is very quiet and very legible. You have stopped feeling hunted. You have stopped feeling anything that could reasonably be called afraid. Whether this is mastery or simply the last thing to go, you have not yet determined. You are no longer certain the distinction matters.

increases.trigger: Feed from a willing mortal during The Stillness
increases.note: The Stillness makes the feeding almost ceremonial. They do not resist. They are not sure they want to.

decreases.trigger: The Stillness ends
decreases.note: The calm costs. This is non-negotiable.

decreases.trigger: Use The Stillness to paralyze a mortal and then harm them while they cannot act

increases.trigger: Enter The Stillness and choose to leave without feeding or acting against any mortal present
increases.note: The power fully expressed and deliberately withheld. This is the hardest kind of restraint.

hooks.text: Something very old has noticed the shape you have become. Not another vampire — older than that category, or outside it. It has been leaving traces that only you would recognize: a specific scent in places you frequent, a color in the shadows that doesn't belong to the light source. Last night it left a message. Not written — spoken, in a voice you heard only in the blood, in a language you should not understand. You understood every word. It said: we have been waiting to see what you would decide. Now we know. Come when you are ready. It did not say what we refers to. It did not say ready for what.

The mortal from The Final Draught — the one who returned the letter, the name, the promise — has been found by someone who knew you before the Embrace and wants to use them as leverage. This person is not supernatural. They are simply thorough and patient and have spent two years building a file on what you have become. The file is accurate. They want one thing in exchange for the mortal's safety and the file's destruction: your name. Your mortal name. The one you have not spoken aloud since the night you chose the other one.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Vampire Manifestation
suggested_use: You have just gained a new vampiric power and want to know how it first surfaces — in your body, your behavior, or the reaction of those around you.
A Blood or Humanity threshold is crossed for the first time and you want to understand what that crossing feels like from the inside.
A scene ends ambiguously and you want the night to decide what it leaves behind.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Vampire Minor Boons
suggested_use: The Vampire Manifestation table sent you here.
You fed with restraint — took only what you needed, from someone willing — and want to know if the blood noticed.
You successfully resisted a feeding urge when it would have been easy not to.

results.mechanic: Gain advantage on your next Persuasion or Deception check.
results.narrative: The words come out perfectly weighted — the right pause, the right timber, the right amount of nothing behind the eyes. You have no idea how you did it. You are learning not to ask.

results.mechanic: Gain advantage on your next Insight check. You read the room correctly before anyone speaks.
results.narrative: The blood runs cold and the thinking sharpens. Detachment, it turns out, is a form of precision.

results.mechanic: Darkvision extends to 120 feet until your next long rest. In complete darkness, you perceive as though in dim light.
results.narrative: The dark opens up like a room with the curtains pulled back. You have stopped thinking of night as an absence of something and started thinking of it as a thing in itself.

results.mechanic: Recover 1d6 HP. The wound closes without scarring, as though it reconsidered.
results.narrative: The body does not heal — it revises. The cut is simply no longer there. You check twice.

results.mechanic: Once this scene, you may move up to 20 feet without triggering opportunity attacks, Perception checks, or memory — you pass through the room and no one can say afterward that they saw you.
results.narrative: The space between heartbeats is longer than most people think. You have learned to move inside it.

results.mechanic: Add +1 Blood to your current meter (cannot exceed maximum).
results.narrative: Something rises in the chest — not warmth exactly, but the memory of it. The blood settles. You feel the balance shift in your favor, briefly.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, you are immune to mundane attempts to read your intentions. Insight checks against you automatically fail unless magical.
results.narrative: There is nothing on your face. Not because you are hiding it — because whatever was there has gone somewhere deeper, somewhere the face does not reach.

results.mechanic: One NPC in your current location becomes passively well-disposed toward you for this session, without knowing why.
results.narrative: Something in your bearing, your stillness, the particular quality of your attention — they have decided, at a level below language, that you are worth knowing. You did not do anything. You were simply there.

results.mechanic: You sense the direction your sire was last known to be. The knowledge is precise but comes with no context.
results.narrative: The blood knows where it came from. It does not explain itself. It simply points, and you feel the pull, and you decide what to do with it.

results.mechanic: Add 1d6 to one damage roll before the end of the scene. The strike lands with the specific precision of something that has been doing this for centuries.
results.narrative: Your hand finds the right place without your mind being consulted. The blow lands heavier than your body should allow. Something older than you used your arm.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Vampire Minor Curses
suggested_use: The Vampire Manifestation table sent you here.
You acted against your nature — fed from an unwilling mortal, used Dominion carelessly, let the hunger show in public — and want to know what it costs beyond the stated mechanic.
A scene ended badly and you want to carry something forward into the next one.

results.mechanic: The next NPC you interact with socially makes their Insight check to detect something wrong about you with advantage.
results.narrative: You catch your reflection in a window and understand immediately what they are seeing. The face is correct. Something behind it isn't.

results.mechanic: At the start of your next scene, Blood decreases by 1 without cause.
results.narrative: You wake — or arrive, or surface from stillness — and the meter has moved. The night took something while you weren't watching.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, you suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks with mortals who are genuinely happy. Their contentment is legible to you in a way that is distracting.
results.narrative: They are warm and they do not know what they have and you remember — just barely — what it was like not to know either. The memory is not pleasant. It is the specific grief of things that cannot be returned.

results.mechanic: You experience a vivid involuntary memory of a feeding — not necessarily recent, not necessarily yours. Make a DC 12 Wisdom save or be incapacitated for 1 round.
results.narrative: It arrives without invitation: the weight of them, the specific sound, the way the hunger quieted afterward. You are not sure whether it is a memory or an instruction.

results.mechanic: Your next long rest restores only half the normal HP. The day takes more than it gives.
results.narrative: The sleep is deep and total and when you surface from it you are still tired in a way that the body has no name for.

results.mechanic: Normal food and drink provide no sustenance until you feed according to your blood_interactions rules. You can still consume them. They taste of nothing.
results.narrative: You eat to appear normal. The bread is chalk. The wine is water with a memory of something better. Your body has made its position clear.

results.mechanic: One NPC you have previously charmed, dominated, or fed from becomes passively uneasy around you this session, without being able to articulate why.
results.narrative: Something in the bond has shifted. You can feel it before you see it — a subtle wrongness in how they hold themselves when you enter the room.

results.mechanic: Your next Persuasion or Deception check is made with disadvantage. The hunger is visible in a way you cannot control.
results.narrative: You are speaking and you can hear yourself speaking and something in the delivery is wrong — too still, too careful, or not careful enough. They cannot name it. They feel it.

results.mechanic: You remember, with complete and useless clarity, one specific mortal thing you can no longer do or experience. The memory surfaces at the worst possible moment this session.
results.narrative: It arrives without warning: the exact weight of a particular afternoon, or the smell of a specific room, or a voice. You were human once. Occasionally the blood reminds you, which is the cruelest thing it does.

results.mechanic: When you next enter a scene with three or more mortals, make a DC 13 Wisdom save or spend your first action cataloguing their heartbeats rather than acting.
results.narrative: The crowd arrives as a wall of warmth and pulse. Your body files it under prey before your mind can object. The first round is always the hardest.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Corruption Effects
suggested_use: The Vampire Manifestation table sent you here.
A Humanity threshold was crossed and you want to understand what the crossing has changed physically or behaviorally.
You used a vampiric power in a way that cost more than the stated mechanic, and want to know what the excess left behind.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, Persuasion checks with mortals who see you in good light are made at disadvantage. The wrongness of your complexion is visible.
results.narrative: You are the wrong color for a living person and you always have been since the Embrace, but today it is more so. You do not know why. The blood does.

results.mechanic: In moments of strong emotion or hunger, your eyes shift — pupils dilate fully, iris bleaches or darkens. Mortals who notice must make a DC 11 Wisdom save or become frightened for 1 round.
results.narrative: You catch it in the glass of a shop window: the eyes of something that has made peace with what it is. The mortal across the room catches it too.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity decreases by 1 — the body is becoming less interested in passing
results.duration: permanent cosmetic, mechanic triggers on emotion/hunger

results.mechanic: Physical contact with mortals now provokes a DC 10 Wisdom save for them — failure means they recoil and remember the contact as unpleasant, even if they cannot say why.
results.narrative: A handshake. A shoulder touched in passing. Their face does something brief and involuntary. You withdraw your hand and they pretend they did not notice. You pretend you did not notice them noticing.

results.mechanic: Your voice takes on a resonance that is difficult to ignore. Persuasion checks gain +2, but Deception checks suffer -2 — the voice compels, but it cannot quite lie the way a human voice can.
results.narrative: You hear it before they react: a harmonic underneath the words, something older than language riding alongside your sentences. It does not speak for you. It amplifies.

results.mechanic: Your shadow does not behave correctly for the rest of the session — it lags, moves against the light source, or is absent briefly. Mortals who notice make a DC 12 Wisdom save or become unsettled.
results.narrative: The shadow is the honest version of you. Today it has stopped pretending.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity decreases by 1 — the world is noticing the seams

results.mechanic: In any scene with more than two mortals, you automatically and involuntarily count heartbeats. You gain +2 to Perception but suffer -1 to all social checks — you are listening to something other than what they are saying.
results.narrative: It is not intentional. The counting happens before you decide to count. Seventy-two. Sixty-eight. That one is afraid. That one has been running. You try to listen to the conversation instead. It is harder than it should be.

results.mechanic: When a mortal makes a sudden movement near you, make a DC 13 Wisdom save or use your reaction to grab or restrain them — not violently, but without intending to. You release immediately, but the interaction has changed.
results.narrative: The reflex fires before the mind does. You have their wrist and then you do not, and the room is very quiet, and you say something that means nothing, and everyone continues as though it did not happen.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity decreases by 1 if the restraint causes genuine distress

results.mechanic: You forget one mortal detail about yourself — a birthday, a preference, a habit, a name you used before the Embrace. It is gone cleanly, without grief, which is the worst part. Humanity decreases by 1.
results.narrative: You reach for it and it is not there. Not suppressed, not buried — absent, the way a tooth is absent after extraction: you know the shape of the space but the thing itself is gone. You note the loss. You do not feel it the way you should.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Vampire Significant Boons
suggested_use: The Vampire Manifestation table sent you here.
You completed a development path requirement and want to know what the blood offers beyond the stated reward.
You survived a Humanity or Blood threshold crossing without losing control, and want to know if the restraint was noticed.

results.mechanic: Add 3 to your Blood Meter (cannot exceed maximum). The body has found a reserve you did not know was there.
results.narrative: Something settles in the chest — not warmth, nothing so human, but a fullness, a sufficiency. The world sharpens. You had forgotten how it looked when you were not running low.

results.mechanic: Ask two yes/no questions about any mortal whose blood you have tasted or smelled this session. The answers are accurate.
results.narrative: The blood is a complete record. You have learned, for a moment, to read the whole of it — not just the hunger, but the history, the fear, the lie they told this morning before they left the house.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, you are immune to fear effects and advantage on saves against mind-affecting magic. There is not enough left of the frightened thing for it to find purchase.
results.narrative: Something tried to reach into your mind and found the room already occupied by something it did not want to meet.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, you move with preternatural elegance. Acrobatics and Athletics checks gain advantage, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from creatures of CR 3 or lower.
results.narrative: The body remembers something it learned before you owned it — a posture, a balance, a way of occupying space that makes violence an afterthought. You did not decide to move this way. You simply do.

results.mechanic: Humanity increases by 1, up to your current maximum. Something you did — or refused to do — was noticed and returned to you.
results.narrative: You cannot identify the moment. That is how it works: the returns are never as legible as the losses. Something is simply there that was not there before, quiet and specific and yours.

results.mechanic: You learn one specific, accurate fact about your sire — their current location, a name they use, a weakness, an obligation they carry. The knowledge comes through the blood without explanation.
results.narrative: The blood knows where it came from and what it came from. Tonight it shares. You are not sure whether this is a gift or a warning that the debt flows both directions.

results.mechanic: One mortal NPC of your choice becomes permanently well-disposed toward you — not dominated, not charmed, genuinely. They have decided, through their own reasoning, that you are worth knowing. This cannot be undone by vampiric means.
results.narrative: They chose. That is the part that stays with you. Not because you did anything to them, but in spite of what you are, which is either the most human thing that has happened to you since the Embrace or the most dangerous.

results.mechanic: Roll on oracle_table_vampire_sire_echoes. That entity offers one specific, concrete, non-repeatable service or piece of knowledge.
results.narrative: Something old has been watching your work. It has decided you have earned a moment of its attention. This is not comfortable. It is, however, useful.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Vampire Major Events
suggested_use: The Vampire Manifestation table sent you here alongside oracle_table_vampire_sire_echoes.
A significant threshold was crossed — Blood at 0, Humanity at a new floor — and you want to know what the world does in response.
A session ends with unresolved tension in the social or predatory sphere and you want to seed the next one.

results.mechanic: An older vampire becomes aware of your existence and has formed an opinion. Roll oracle_table_vampire_sire_echoes to determine who.
results.narrative: Word moves through the bloodlines in ways that have nothing to do with speech. Something ancient has filed you under a category you cannot yet read.

results.mechanic: A mortal hunter or investigator has picked up your trail. They will appear once per session until the situation is resolved.
results.narrative: The file on you is thin but growing. They do not know what you are yet. They know something is wrong, and they are the kind of person who follows that feeling.

results.mechanic: A mortal you have previously fed from or dominated seeks you out — not with hostility, but with need. They require something only you can provide, and they are not fully certain why they came to you.
results.narrative: The bond you made, or the one that formed without your intention, has pulled them back. They stand at your door with a look you recognize: they do not understand the pull, but they followed it.

results.mechanic: Another vampire — or something that feeds in a similar manner — has moved into your territory. They are not hostile, but they are present, and the mortals you rely on are beginning to show signs of over-feeding.
results.narrative: You notice it in the faces of the people you pass: a hollowness, a pallor, a vagueness in the eyes. Someone else is working this ground. They are not careful.

results.mechanic: Your sire makes contact — directly or through an intermediary. They want something. Roll oracle_table_vampire_sire_echoes to determine the nature of the contact.
results.narrative: The message arrives in a way that confirms they have been watching. They know where you sleep. Of course they do. They chose it.

results.mechanic: A mortal from before the Embrace recognizes you. They are certain it is you. They are also certain you look exactly as you did years ago, which is impossible. They have not yet decided what to do with this.
results.narrative: The name they use is your old one. You have not heard it in — you calculate the years and the number surprises you. They are looking at you with the specific expression of someone whose world is rearranging itself around a fact they cannot yet accept.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity check — this encounter may trigger a recovery or a loss depending on how you handle it

results.mechanic: You learn something about the vampire who made you — a crime, a debt, a bloodline they belong to, an enemy they have made. The information arrives through the blood, without context. It is accurate and it changes something.
results.narrative: The blood is a record of everything that has ever moved through the line you belong to. Tonight it shows you a page you were not looking for. You cannot unread it.

results.mechanic: During your next long rest you experience a blood vision — a scene from the past or future, vivid and accurate. Roll 1d4: 1-2 it concerns your sire; 3 it concerns a mortal currently in your life; 4 it concerns something you will do, not something you have done. The vision cannot be ignored. It will recur until acted upon.
results.narrative: You go still for the day and the blood shows you something. It does not explain. It does not ask permission. It simply plays, complete and precise and urgent, and when you surface from it you carry the image like a debt.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Dark Ascension
suggested_use: The Vampire Manifestation table sent you here alongside oracle_table_vampire_price_to_pay.
Humanity has reached 2 or Blood has hit 0 for the third time.
You have completed the tier 4 power and want to understand what the ascension has cost beyond the stated mechanic.

results.mechanic: One aspect of your physical appearance becomes permanently, subtly wrong — something mortals cannot name but cannot ignore. All Persuasion checks with strangers are made at disadvantage until you find a way to conceal or explain it.
results.narrative: The mirror is honest in a way that is no longer useful. Whatever it is — the stillness of the chest, the temperature of the skin, the eyes — it has stopped being something you can manage in passing. It is simply what you look like now.

results.mechanic: Roll oracle_table_vampire_sire_echoes. That entity now has a standing claim on one future action of yours, unspecified, to be named when they choose.
results.narrative: Something old has decided you owe it something. You did not agree to this. The blood did not ask you.

results.mechanic: One community, faction, or social circle that previously accepted you becomes permanently hostile. A rumor has reached them — not entirely wrong — and they have acted on it.
results.narrative: You do not know what was said, only that the door is closed now and the faces on the other side of it have changed into something you recognize: the specific blankness of people who have decided not to know you.

results.mechanic: Blood Meter can no longer be raised above 7 by normal feeding. Reaching maximum requires a significant source — a powerful mortal, another supernatural creature, or a ritual.
results.narrative: The ordinary is no longer enough. The body has developed opinions about what it considers sufficient, and common blood no longer qualifies. You have become specific in your requirements, which is another word for something you are trying not to say.
results.blood_effect_note: Blood maximum effectively reduced to 7 for normal feeding

results.mechanic: Gain a permanent compulsion tied to Blood levels. When Blood drops to 3 or below, you must succeed a DC 15 Wisdom save to avoid feeding from the nearest available mortal regardless of circumstance or relationship.
results.narrative: It is not a decision. It is a reflex. The body has written a standing instruction and sealed it below the level of deliberate thought. You know it is there. You cannot always stop it.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity decreases by 1 — the compulsion is evidence of what you have become

results.mechanic: You qualify for The Eternal if you do not already have it. Roll oracle_table_vampire_price_to_pay twice — both costs apply. Additionally, Humanity decreases by 1 immediately.
results.narrative: This is not a reward. The blood does not give rewards. This is what you have become given form and recognition — something old enough to have a name, powerful enough that the names of things like you have been written down in books kept in locked rooms. The books are not flattering.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: The Price to Pay
suggested_use: The Dark Ascension table sent you here.
You acquired a tier 3 or tier 4 power and want to know what it cost beyond the stated mechanic.
You pushed a vampiric ability further than its stated limits and want the oracle to determine what that excess extracted.

results.mechanic: Your vampiric name — the one you chose or the one others have given you — is now known to an entity you have not met. They will make contact within three sessions.
results.narrative: Names are the oldest currency. You spent yours without knowing you were spending it.

results.mechanic: One genuine relationship with a mortal — not a dominated contact, an actual connection — becomes strained. They have noticed something they cannot articulate and have begun pulling away.
results.narrative: You did not do anything. That is the thing about this cost — it is not punishment for an action. It is just the distance, widening on its own, the way cold things push warmth away.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity decreases by 1 if the relationship is severed entirely

results.mechanic: Every mortal you have fed from this month experiences a single, vivid, inexplicable dream about you. Most will dismiss it. 1d4 of them will not.
results.narrative: The blood goes both ways. You drew from them; now something of you is in their sleep, showing them fragments they were not meant to see. Most will tell themselves it was nothing. Some will start asking questions.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, you take 1 point of damage per round in direct sunlight. This is new. It was not this bad before.
results.narrative: The sun has noticed the change. It adjusts accordingly.
results.blood_effect_note: Blood decreases by 1 per round in direct sunlight

results.mechanic: One Court member (or mortal contact, if Court is not yet established) transfers their loyalty to another vampire without explanation. They do not know they have done it. You feel the loss in the blood before you understand it intellectually.
results.narrative: The bond snapped and you felt it — a clean break, like a thread cut with scissors. Somewhere, someone made them a better offer. Or someone older simply reached in and took them. The blood does not explain which.

results.mechanic: For the next three sessions, feeding from animals provides 0 Blood instead of 1. The body has refined its requirements. Common blood will no longer do.
results.narrative: You tried. The animal blood sits wrong — thin and cold and insufficient in a way that is new. The body has moved past something, and it is not willing to go back.
results.blood_effect_note: no change to Blood, but animal feeding becomes ineffective for 3 sessions

results.mechanic: You gain a persistent, accurate memory from your sire's past — not your own experience, but theirs. It is complete, sensory, and arrives without warning once per session until you have done something with it. Humanity decreases by 1.
results.narrative: The blood is a record and you have gone deep enough into it to read pages that do not belong to you. You experience the memory from inside a body that is not yours, doing things you did not choose, and you cannot look away until it finishes.
results.humanity_effect_note: Humanity decreases by 1 — the memory is of something your sire did, and knowing it makes you complicit in a way you did not agree to

results.mechanic: An entity older than your sire asserts a claim on you — not hostile, not negotiated, simply present, the way property rights are present. You will meet them within two sessions. They already know everything about you. They have had time.
results.narrative: The bloodline is a chain, and chains have ends you have not seen yet. Something at the far end of yours has noticed the vibration. It has been waiting, with the patience of something that does not experience time the way you do, for a suitable moment to introduce itself.

vampirism_powers.name: Oracle: Sire Echoes
suggested_use: Another table sent you here to determine the nature of an elder, sire, or bloodline contact.
You want to know who is paying attention to your development and what their disposition is.
A major event has occurred and you want to seed the bloodline's response into the next session.

results.mechanic: An elder vampire who made you (or made the one who made you) has been observing your development with the detached interest of someone reviewing an investment. They are not hostile. They have a use for you in mind that they have not yet disclosed.
results.narrative: The letters arrive correctly addressed — not to your mortal name, to the other one. They are polite and contain nothing threatening and you understand, reading them, that the politeness is the threat.

results.mechanic: Your sire made you and left. They did not intend to return. Something you have done has made them reconsider. They are not sure yet whether their interest is protective or proprietary.
results.narrative: You thought you had been forgotten. The evidence suggests you were simply filed. They knew where you were the entire time. They simply had not decided what to do about it.

results.mechanic: Another vampire of comparable age and power to your sire has become aware of you and does not approve of your existence, your methods, or both. They have not acted yet. They are deciding whether you are worth the energy.
results.narrative: You have moved into someone else's story without knowing you were doing it. They have been in this city — or this life, or this feeding ground — for longer than you, and they have not forgotten it.

results.mechanic: An older vampire has decided, for reasons of their own, that your development is worth investing in. They offer guidance, information, or access — at a cost that will become clear later. Roll 1d4: 1-2 the cost is a service; 3 the cost is loyalty; 4 the cost is something they have not named yet.
results.narrative: They sit across from you and explain things in the tone of someone who has explained them many times before, to people who did not survive long enough to make the explanation worthwhile. They seem to think you might be different. You are not sure whether to be flattered.

results.mechanic: A structured group of vampires — a court, a bloodline, a conspiracy — has taken note of you and sent an emissary. They want you affiliated. The terms are described as favorable. They always are, at first.
results.narrative: The emissary is charming and says the right things and you notice, underneath the charm, the specific quality of someone who has done this before and knows exactly which words open which doors.

results.mechanic: Your sire is in trouble. The nature of the trouble (hunters, elder enemies, a debt called in) determines the shape of the contact — they need something from you, and the asking is not comfortable for either of you.
results.narrative: You did not think you would feel anything, hearing they were in danger. You feel something. It is complicated and you do not have a name for it that does not also apply to things you would rather not admit.

results.mechanic: Your sire made an agreement on your behalf before you existed as a vampire. That agreement is now due. You did not consent to it. The party collecting does not consider this relevant.
results.narrative: The bloodline carries its debts forward, the way families carry their names. You are the current holder of something your sire signed in your behalf. The signature was made in blood, which means it is binding in ways that legal arguments do not address.

results.mechanic: Something very old — older than your sire's sire, old enough that its name has been forgotten by everyone except itself — has noticed you. It does not want anything yet. It is simply aware. This is either the best or worst thing that has happened to you. Possibly both.
results.narrative: You feel it the way you feel changes in air pressure: not precisely, but certainly. Something has added you to a list it has been keeping for a very long time. The list does not have categories. It simply has names.

eidolon_powers.name: The Binding
eidolon_powers.trigger: You did not find it. It found the crack in you — the moment of extremity, the threshold crossed alone, the prayer spoken to nothing that turned out not to be nothing. Perhaps you called it deliberately, tracing old diagrams in a locked room with shaking hands. Perhaps it arrived uninvited through a wound, a grief, a door left open in a moment of desperation. The nature of the entity is yours to determine: divine remnant, demonic presence, elemental intelligence, planar fragment, something that defies category entirely. What matters is not what it is. What matters is that it is now inside you, and the inside of you has changed shape to accommodate it.
eidolon_powers.setting: The moment of Binding has no single setting — it happens wherever you are when you are most alone and most at the edge of yourself. What is consistent: a stillness that precedes it, as though the air has been waiting. A pressure behind the sternum, not painful, more like a key turning. A voice — or not a voice, more an impression of one — that does not use words so much as deposit meaning directly into the part of your mind that understands things before language gets to them. And then the sensation of something vast making itself small to fit inside the space you have available, and the understanding that the space will have to expand.

player_choice.prompt: The entity has found you. It has not asked permission — but it pauses, at the threshold of the Binding, with the quality of something that is capable of asking and has chosen to, once, as a courtesy it does not strictly owe you. It wants to know how you will meet it.

options.label: Open yourself to it completely. Do not resist.
options.consequence: Proceed to the skill check with advantage. The Binding is clean and total. The entity notes your willingness. It will remember this.

options.label: Speak to it. Set a condition — one thing you will not surrender.
options.consequence: Proceed to the skill check. The entity considers your condition. Whether it agrees is determined by the outcome.

options.label: Fight it. Make it take you rather than accept the gift.
options.consequence: Proceed to the skill check with disadvantage. The Binding happens anyway. But the entity has learned something about you that you may not have intended to reveal.

skill_check.success: Acquire The Shared Voice. The Binding completes cleanly. Dominance starts at 1 — the entity is present but not yet pressing.
skill_check.failure: Acquire The Shared Voice. The Binding completes roughly. Dominance starts at 3 and you gain 1 level of exhaustion. The entity did not mean to hurt you. It is simply larger than the space.
skill_check.critical_success: Acquire The Shared Voice. Dominance starts at 0. The entity offers one piece of information about itself — its name, its nature, or its purpose — freely and without being asked. This information is accurate.

eidolon_powers.narrative_outcome: The world is the same. You are standing in the same place, in the same body, wearing the same clothes. Everything is identical except that you are no longer alone in here, and you know, with the specific certainty of something that cannot be unfelt, that you never will be again. The entity does not speak immediately. It settles. It learns the architecture of you — the rooms you keep locked, the ones you leave open, the ones you have forgotten exist. You feel it moving through you with the careful attention of something that has just acquired a home and is deciding what to do with the space.

eidolon_powers.name: The Shared Voice
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Survive the Binding and remain conscious long enough to hear what the entity says first.

effects.mechanic: The Dominance Meter tracks the eidolon's presence in your body (min 0, max 10, starts at 1 after Binding). Once per scene, you may call on the eidolon's knowledge to add +2 to any Intelligence or Wisdom check. Each use increases Dominance by 1. When Dominance reaches 0, you lose access to all eidolon powers until you spend a short rest in deliberate contact with the entity. When Dominance reaches 10, the eidolon acts autonomously once per scene — not against you, but without asking.
effects.narrative: There is a second opinion on everything now. You think a thought and it is already there beside it — older, stranger, carrying context from places you have never been. You have stopped being startled by it. This is either adaptation or the first stage of something else, and you have not yet determined which.

0.mechanic: Dominance 0: eidolon powers unavailable. The entity is present but unreachable — it has withdrawn to the minimum. Spend a short rest in deliberate internal communication to restore access.
0.narrative: The silence is louder than you expected. You did not realize how much of your thinking had started running through the second channel until the channel went quiet.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: the +2 bonus increases to +3. However, the entity begins offering unsolicited observations — once per scene the GM may have it supply information you did not ask for, which may or may not be welcome.
4.narrative: It has opinions now. Not commands — observations, corrections, annotations in the margin of your experience. You did not ask for a second narrator. You have one.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: all eidolon power bonuses increase by 1. The entity acts autonomously once per scene — it may speak through you, redirect your attention, or make a single skill check using your modifiers without your direction. It is not hostile. It has priorities that are not always yours.
7.narrative: The line between your impulses and its suggestions has become difficult to locate. You find yourself saying things you did not decide to say, moving toward things you did not decide to approach. The entity would describe this as collaboration. You are still deciding what to call it.

increases.trigger: Activate any eidolon power
The entity acts in a situation you could not control
increases.note: Loss of control feeds further loss of control.

decreases.trigger: Spend a short rest in deliberate internal negotiation with the entity — acknowledge its presence and set a boundary
decreases.note: The entity respects boundaries that are stated clearly. For now.

decreases.trigger: Complete a scene acting entirely against the entity's expressed preferences
decreases.note: Resistance costs something. It also proves something.

development_paths.name: The Martial Channel
development_paths.requirement: Use The Shared Voice bonus in 3 separate combat situations. In at least 1, the entity's knowledge was the deciding factor.
development_paths.result: Unlocks access to 'The Borrowed Fist' (tier 1 lateral A).

development_paths.name: The Perception Channel
development_paths.requirement: Use The Shared Voice bonus in 3 separate non-combat situations requiring knowledge or awareness. In at least 1, act on the entity's unsolicited input.
development_paths.result: Unlocks access to 'The Opened Eye' (tier 1 lateral B).

hooks.text: The entity has a name. You did not ask for it — it simply arrived one morning, fully formed, in the part of your mind where your own name usually sits. You are not sure whether knowing it gives you power over the entity or gives the entity a stronger claim on you. You have not yet said it aloud. You are aware that saying it aloud would be a kind of decision.

A scholar of planar theory has published a monograph describing, with uncomfortable accuracy, the behavioral changes associated with an eidolon bonding. The monograph has a clinical tone and seventeen documented case studies. You are not one of them. You are reading it and recognizing things you have not told anyone. The scholar is still alive and still researching. They have left a correspondence address.

eidolon_powers.name: The Borrowed Fist
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Martial Channel development path — use the eidolon's knowledge in combat until the entity understands what your body is trying to do and begins anticipating it.

effects.mechanic: Once per combat, you may channel the eidolon's physical nature through your strikes. The next melee attack deals an additional 1d8 damage of a type appropriate to the eidolon's nature (radiant, necrotic, force, fire — established at Binding). Costs 1 Dominance.
effects.narrative: The strike lands with something behind it that is not muscle. You feel the entity lean into the blow — not controlling the arm, not yet, but lending it weight from somewhere else entirely. The damage is yours. The force behind it is not.

0.mechanic: Dominance 0: The Borrowed Fist unavailable.
0.narrative: Without the connection, the strikes are just strikes. Yours, entirely, which tonight feels like a loss.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: bonus damage increases to 2d8. On a critical hit, the target must make a DC 13 Constitution save or be briefly stunned by the alien force of the impact — disoriented for 1 round.
4.narrative: The entity is more present now and the blows carry more of it. The people on the receiving end do not always recover the way they should. Something in the damage is wrong in a way that flesh is not designed to handle.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: The Borrowed Fist activates automatically on your first attack each combat. You cannot choose not to use it. The damage bonus increases to 2d10. After combat, make a DC 13 Wisdom save or the entity retains 1 point of increased presence — Dominance does not decrease at the end of the scene.
7.narrative: The entity has learned the shape of a fight and does not wait for an invitation anymore. The first blow is always shared now. You feel the pleasure it takes in the contact, which is different from your own, and the difference is getting harder to locate.

increases.trigger: Activate The Borrowed Fist
Kill a creature using The Borrowed Fist
increases.note: The entity experiences the kill alongside you. It finds this meaningful in ways you are still mapping.

decreases.trigger: Refuse to use The Borrowed Fist in a combat where it would have been decisive
decreases.note: Deliberate restraint, at cost, communicates something to the entity.

development_paths.name: The Full Channel
development_paths.requirement: Use The Borrowed Fist in 5 separate combats. In at least 2, the entity's autonomous action at Dominance 7+ was not what you would have chosen.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Threshold Contest'.

hooks.text: Someone witnessed a fight in which you used The Borrowed Fist and survived long enough to describe what they saw. Their description is circulating in a specific community — not hunters, not scholars — people who have been waiting for someone who can do exactly what you did. They have sent a representative. The representative's eyes are the wrong color. You recognize the quality of the wrongness.

A creature of the same nature as your eidolon — not the entity itself, something related, a fragment or an echo — has manifested in the district and is causing damage that looks, to anyone who knows what to look for, like your damage. The authorities are looking for you. The entity, when consulted, is uncharacteristically quiet on the subject of the other presence.

eidolon_powers.name: The Opened Eye
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Perception Channel development path — act on the entity's unsolicited input until the boundary between your perception and its perception becomes genuinely unclear.

effects.mechanic: You perceive a layer of reality the entity inhabits — spirits, planar residue, magical workings, emotional impressions left on objects and places. Once per scene, you may ask one yes/no question about the true nature of a person, place, or object within 30 feet. The entity answers accurately. Costs 1 Dominance.
effects.narrative: The world has a second layer and you can see it now, imperfectly, through the entity's perception overlaid on your own. It is not always helpful. Knowing the emotional history of every object in a room is interesting and frequently distressing. The entity does not have a filter. It shows you everything it sees. You are learning to look at what matters.

0.mechanic: Dominance 0: The Opened Eye unavailable.
0.narrative: The second layer closes. The world is flat again. You had forgotten how much information you had started taking for granted.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: you may now ask two questions per scene instead of one. Additionally, the entity volunteers one unrequested perception per long rest — something it has noticed that it considers important. You do not control what it chooses to share.
4.narrative: The entity has opinions about what you should know. They do not always align with what you want to know, which is a distinction it does not fully understand.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: perception is always partially active — you automatically detect active magical effects, invisible creatures, and strong emotional impressions without using your action. However, overwhelming environments (cities, crowds, places of great historical weight) require a DC 13 Wisdom save or impose disadvantage on Concentration checks — the signal is too loud.
7.narrative: You have stopped being able to turn it off completely. The city is a palimpsest — every street a record of everything that has happened on it, every face carrying its own weather system of history and intention. It is extraordinary. It is exhausting. The entity does not understand why you would want to turn it off.

increases.trigger: Activate The Opened Eye
Act on the entity's unrequested perception
increases.note: Every time you trust it, it grows.

decreases.trigger: Deliberately ignore the entity's perception in favor of your own judgment, and be proven right
decreases.note: Your own sight matters. Proving it matters to the entity too.

development_paths.name: The Deep Sight
development_paths.requirement: Use The Opened Eye to act on information in 4 separate scenes. In at least 1, the information changed a decision in a way that cost you something personally.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Threshold Contest'.

hooks.text: The Opened Eye has shown you something about a person you trusted — an impression left on an object they gave you, or a residue in a room they frequent. The information is accurate and it changes things. The entity presents it without commentary, which is somehow worse than if it had an opinion. You have to decide what to do with it alone.

A place in the district is broadcasting something through the second layer so loudly that you cannot enter without the Opened Eye activating involuntarily. The entity becomes agitated near it — not frightened, something more like recognition. Whatever is at the center of it has been there for a long time. It has been waiting for something with the right kind of perception to notice it.

eidolon_powers.name: Trial: The Threshold Contest
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: The trial does not arrive as an external event. It arrives as an internal one: a night when the entity presses harder than usual, testing the boundary between your will and its presence, and you realize the boundary needs to be established deliberately or it will be established for you.

effects.mechanic: A three-phase internal ordeal. Phase 1: The Press — the entity pushes to Dominance 7 deliberately, regardless of current level. Make a DC 14 Wisdom save to remain oriented. Phase 2: The Negotiation — while at Dominance 7, conduct a deliberate internal dialogue with the entity. Establish one rule it will follow. No check — but the rule must be specific, and the entity must find it acceptable (GM/oracle adjudicates). Phase 3: The Return — reduce Dominance by 3 through will alone, without external assistance. DC 15 Charisma save. Succeed on phases 1 and 3 to complete the trial. Phase 2 cannot be failed, only avoided — avoiding it ends the trial without completion.
effects.narrative: The contest is not about winning. The entity is not trying to destroy you — it is trying to understand exactly how much of you there is. The trial is your answer to that question, given in a language it understands: not words, not intention, but the specific weight of a will that refuses to dissolve.

skill_checks.success: Hold orientation at Dominance 7. Proceed to phase 2.
skill_checks.failure: The entity speaks through you once — one sentence, to whoever is nearest. You do not choose the sentence. Proceed to phase 2 with Dominance at 8.

skill_checks.success: Dominance drops by 3. The trial is complete. The entity has recorded the boundary.
skill_checks.failure: Dominance drops by 1 instead. The trial resets to phase 1. Dominance costs from the failed attempt carry forward.

eidolon_powers.name: The Manifest Form
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Threshold Contest. The morning after, you find that the entity has left a visible mark — a detail of your appearance that was not there before, appropriate to its nature. The mark is the key.

effects.mechanic: Once per long rest, allow the entity to partially manifest through your body for up to 1 minute. While manifesting: you gain resistance to one damage type appropriate to the eidolon's nature, your unarmed strikes deal 1d10 damage of the eidolon's type, and you emanate an aura of 10 feet that forces creatures of CR 2 or lower to make a DC 14 Wisdom save or become frightened. Costs 3 Dominance on activation, plus 1 per round sustained beyond the first.
effects.narrative: The body becomes a door. What comes through it is still you — your hands, your face, your voice — but behind everything, visible to those who know what to look for, is the shape of something else pressing through from the other side. You feel it occupying your skeleton with the practiced ease of something that has been waiting for this exact opportunity. The feeling is not painful. That is the part you keep returning to.

0.mechanic: Dominance 0: The Manifest Form unavailable.
0.narrative: The door is closed. The entity is there — you can feel it — but it has no way through.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: the frightened aura DC increases to 16. Additionally, while manifesting, you have advantage on saves against effects from creatures of the eidolon's opposed nature.
4.narrative: The entity is more fully present and its presence is more legible. Things that should not be afraid of you are afraid of you. Things that are afraid of your eidolon's nature specifically give you a wide berth.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: The Manifest Form activates automatically when you drop to 0 HP, preventing unconsciousness for 1 round. While in this automatic manifestation, Dominance cannot increase further — the entity is already fully present. After the round ends, you either stabilize or fall normally. The entity's choice, not yours.
7.narrative: The entity has a stake in your survival that has nothing to do with generosity. When you fall, it catches you, briefly, with the specific self-interest of something that does not want to lose its house. You are alive. It made the decision. You are still deciding how you feel about that.
