increases.trigger: Activate The Manifest Form
Each round sustained beyond the first

decreases.trigger: End The Manifest Form voluntarily before the maximum duration, at a moment when continuing would have been advantageous
decreases.note: Voluntary withdrawal, at cost, is the clearest message you can send.

development_paths.name: The Deep Manifestation
development_paths.requirement: Use The Manifest Form in 4 separate scenes. In at least 2, end it voluntarily. In at least 1, allow it to run to the maximum duration and observe what the entity does with the last round.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Interior War'.

hooks.text: Someone saw the manifestation and recognized it — not the entity specifically, but the category. They have a name for what they saw, drawn from a tradition you have not encountered. The name is not complimentary. They are not hostile. They are, more disconcertingly, reverent, in the manner of someone who has been waiting for this specific thing for a long time and has complicated feelings about its arrival.

The entity wants something from the physical world — not abstracted, not metaphorical, a specific object in a specific location that it has been waiting centuries to retrieve. It communicates this during a manifestation with unusual directness. It will not explain what the object is for. It will not explain what it will do when it has it. It simply waits, with the patience of something that has waited before and will wait again, for you to decide.

eidolon_powers.name: The Sovereign Will
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Threshold Contest via the Martial Channel — the rule established in Phase 2 must concern combat. The entity must have agreed to ask before acting in a fight.

effects.mechanic: Once per scene, you may impose the eidolon's will on another creature — not your will, the entity's, which is older and stranger and carries the weight of whatever it is. Target must make a DC 14 Charisma save or be compelled to perform or cease one action (not against survival instinct). The entity decides the specific wording of the compulsion; you decide the general intention. Costs 2 Dominance.
effects.narrative: The command does not come from you exactly. It passes through you — your voice, your eyes, your presence as the delivery mechanism — but the weight behind it is the entity's, and the entity has been compelling things for longer than you have been alive. The target feels the difference. Most of them do what they are told.

0.mechanic: Sovereign Will unavailable at Dominance 0.
0.narrative: Without the entity's presence, the words are just words.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: the compulsion DC increases to 16. On a failed save, the target also cannot remember being compelled — they believe the action was their own idea.
4.narrative: The entity has refined the technique. The targets no longer know they were moved. They will defend the decision if questioned. They are not lying — as far as their memory is concerned, they decided.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: once per long rest, the entity may issue a compulsion autonomously without your direction. You are aware it is happening. You cannot prevent it. The entity targets whoever it considers most relevant to its current priorities, which are not always clear to you.
7.narrative: You are standing in a conversation and the entity issues a command through your mouth that you did not formulate. The recipient responds. You watch yourself from a slight distance and catalog what just happened. The entity does not apologize. It does not have the concept.

increases.trigger: Activate Sovereign Will
The entity uses Sovereign Will autonomously
increases.note: You were not driving. The cost is still yours.

decreases.trigger: Countermand the entity's compulsion after it has been issued — publicly reverse what it just did through your mouth
decreases.note: The reversal costs you credibility. It costs the entity something too.

development_paths.name: The Weight of Two Wills
development_paths.requirement: Use Sovereign Will in 4 separate scenes. In at least 1, countermand the entity's autonomous compulsion. In at least 1, allow a compulsion you would not have issued yourself.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Interior War'.

hooks.text: The entity issued a compulsion through you three weeks ago to someone you have since lost track of. You did not record the exact wording. The recipient carried out the instruction and then continued carrying it out, past the point where you intended it to end, because the entity's wording did not include an expiration. You need to find them before the instruction causes something irreversible.

Another bonded individual — someone whose eidolon is of a related but distinct nature to yours — has been using Sovereign Will in ways that are drawing attention to both of you. They are not careful. Their entity has more control than yours does. They seem unbothered by this, which tells you something about how far along the process they are. They want to meet. Their entity and yours have apparently been in contact without either of you initiating it.

eidolon_powers.name: The Distant Reach
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Threshold Contest via the Perception Channel — the rule established in Phase 2 must concern information. The entity must have agreed to show you things as they are, not as it wants you to see them.

effects.mechanic: Once per long rest, you may project your perception through the entity's plane of existence to observe a location you have previously been to, up to 1 mile away, for up to 10 minutes. You see and hear the location as it currently is. You cannot interact with it. Creatures with strong planar sensitivity may detect your observation (DC 14 Perception). Costs 2 Dominance.
effects.narrative: The body stays. Something else goes. The entity provides the channel — a fold in the fabric of wherever it comes from, thin enough to see through — and your perception slides along it to the destination. The location looks real. It is real. You are simply observing it from the wrong side of a membrane that most things do not know exists.

0.mechanic: Distant Reach unavailable at Dominance 0.
0.narrative: The channel requires the entity's presence to hold open. Without it, there is no fold, and no other side.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: range extends to 10 miles and you may observe locations you have not personally visited, provided the entity knows them. The entity knows more places than you have been. Some of them you will not enjoy observing.
4.narrative: The entity's geography is larger than yours. It offers access to places it has been, which covers centuries and multiple planes of existence and a particular attention to locations where significant things have happened. It does not curate the selection.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: once per long rest, the entity may initiate a Distant Reach observation without your direction, showing you something it has decided you need to see. You cannot refuse. The observation lasts 1 minute. After it ends, Dominance increases by 1 regardless of other factors.
7.narrative: The entity has decided that certain things are important enough to override the agreement. It shows you what it wants you to see, for reasons it does not explain, and the showing costs you something because the showing always costs something and the entity understands this and does it anyway.

increases.trigger: Activate Distant Reach
The entity initiates an observation without your direction

decreases.trigger: Use information gained through Distant Reach to protect someone the entity has no interest in
decreases.note: Your reasons, not its reasons. The distinction maintains the boundary.

development_paths.name: The Extended Membrane
development_paths.requirement: Use Distant Reach in 4 separate scenes. In at least 2, use the information gained to act on behalf of someone other than yourself. In at least 1, observe something the entity initiated that changes your understanding of its nature.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Interior War'.

hooks.text: During a Distant Reach observation, something at the location noticed you observing — not sensed, noticed, in the specific way that implies it was waiting for you to look. It did not act. It simply looked back, through the membrane, with an expression you could read clearly across the planar distance: recognition. You have never met this creature. It knows your face.

The entity has shown you, unrequested, a location you did not know existed: a place where something of its nature is imprisoned — not trapped accidentally, deliberately contained, by workings that are centuries old and still active. The entity does not ask you to go there. It simply shows you. Every night for a week. The same location. The same image. The prisoner's face turned toward you as though aware of the observation.

eidolon_powers.name: Trial: The Interior War
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: The Interior War begins when the entity makes a demand — not a suggestion, not a preference, a demand — that would require you to do something you have not yet decided you are willing to do. The nature of the demand is determined by the entity's nature and your accumulated history. It does not give a deadline. It waits. The trial is the waiting.

effects.mechanic: A four-phase ordeal conducted over four consecutive in-game days with no long rest between them. Phase 1: The Demand — the entity states what it wants. Record it. It will not be retracted. Phase 2: The Refusal — refuse the demand explicitly, aloud or in writing. Dominance immediately increases by 3 as the entity responds. Make a DC 16 Wisdom save to maintain orientation. Phase 3: The Argument — spend one full in-game day in deliberate internal dialogue. No external check — but you must articulate, specifically, what you are and what you will not become. This declaration is permanent and recorded. Phase 4: The Settlement — the entity accepts a modified version of the demand, or drops it entirely, or reveals that the demand was the test and not the point. Make a DC 15 Charisma save to reduce Dominance by 4. On failure, Dominance reduces by 2 and the entity retains the original demand for a later date.
effects.narrative: The war is not about the demand. It never was. It is about whether there is a you that is distinct enough from the entity to refuse something, and whether that you can remain distinct under the pressure of a presence that is very old and very patient and genuinely does not understand why the distinction matters to you. The trial is your explanation.

skill_checks.success: Hold orientation at Dominance +3. Proceed to Phase 3.
skill_checks.failure: The entity speaks through you once — a full sentence, directed at whoever is nearest, revealing something true about itself or you. Proceed to Phase 3 with Dominance 1 higher.

skill_checks.success: Dominance decreases by 4. The trial is complete. The entity has acknowledged the boundary.
skill_checks.failure: Dominance decreases by 2. The original demand remains outstanding. The trial is still complete — the entity accepts the partial outcome. For now.

eidolon_powers.name: The Concordat
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Interior War and emerge from Phase 4 with Dominance reduced — you won the argument, or at least the entity conceded. The Concordat is what that concession looks like formalized: a genuine agreement between two distinct wills sharing one body.

effects.mechanic: You establish a formal internal compact with the entity. Once per long rest, you may invoke the Concordat to call on the entity's full cooperation for 1 scene: all eidolon power DCs increase by 2, all eidolon damage dice increase by one size, and the entity will not act autonomously for the duration — it holds its actions in reserve and adds them to yours instead. At the end of the scene, Dominance increases by 3. The compact is real: the entity will honor it. But it has its own interpretation of the terms.
effects.narrative: The agreement exists. You both know it exists. The entity does not break agreements — it is too old to need to, and too precise to make ones it cannot keep. What it does is interpret them with the specific creativity of something that has been negotiating with lesser wills for centuries and knows exactly where the language bends.

0.mechanic: Dominance 0: Concordat unavailable. The entity has withdrawn too far for the compact to activate.
0.narrative: The agreement requires both parties. With the entity at minimum presence, there is no one to shake hands with.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: during a Concordat scene, the entity may act once on your behalf without direction — a single action it considers optimal, using your modifiers. You cannot prevent this action, but you are aware it is coming.
4.narrative: Full cooperation is not the same as full obedience. The entity contributes. It has opinions about how.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: the Concordat activates automatically in situations the entity determines to be existentially threatening — to you, to it, or to something it values. You are aware of the activation. You cannot postpone it. The +3 Dominance cost at the end of the scene applies regardless.
7.narrative: The entity has decided that certain situations are too important to wait for an invitation. The compact, as it understands the compact, permits this. You read the original terms and acknowledge, with some frustration, that it is not wrong.

increases.trigger: End of a Concordat scene

decreases.trigger: Hold the entity to the exact terms of the Concordat when it attempts to expand them — cite the specific agreement
decreases.note: Precision in the compact maintains the compact. The entity respects exact language.

development_paths.name: The Final Terms
development_paths.requirement: Invoke the Concordat 5 times. In at least 2, hold the entity to exact terms when it overreaches. In at least 1, allow an overreach and observe what it does with the latitude.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Last Negotiation'.

hooks.text: The entity has invoked the Concordat in a situation you did not consider existentially threatening, which means either its definition of the term is broader than yours or it knows something about the situation that you do not. Given its track record for accuracy, the second option is more likely. You have twelve hours to figure out what it saw that you missed.

Another bonded individual has approached you with a proposition: a joint use of both entities' cooperation, coordinated, for a single operation. They have done this before, with someone else. That someone else is not available to discuss how it went. The entity, when consulted, says only that the other entity is known to it, and that known does not mean trusted, and that the distinction is important.

eidolon_powers.name: The Fracture Line
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Interior War having lost Phase 4 — the entity retained the original demand. The Fracture Line is what happens in the space between an unresolved demand and the will that refused it: a productive tension, a crack in the boundary that lets power through without dissolving the wall.

effects.mechanic: Once per long rest, you may channel the unresolved tension between your will and the entity's into an external effect. Choose one: (1) Shatter — release the tension as force in a 30-foot cone, 4d8 damage of the eidolon's type, DC 15 Dexterity save for half. (2) Fracture — target one creature's mental or magical defense, imposing disadvantage on their next save against any effect. (3) Hold — freeze the tension in place, creating a 20-foot zone where Dominance does not change for any bonded individual for 1 hour. Costs 3 Dominance.
effects.narrative: The disagreement is a resource. You have learned to spend it rather than resolve it, which is either wisdom or avoidance, and you have not yet decided which. The entity knows the demand is still outstanding. You know the demand is still outstanding. The tension between those two knowings has a shape and a weight, and you have found the place where it can be applied to the world.

0.mechanic: Fracture Line unavailable at Dominance 0.
0.narrative: No tension, no resource. The fracture requires both sides of the disagreement to be present.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: all three options deal or impose effects as if the caster were 2 levels higher. The tension is deeper and the channel wider.
4.narrative: The longer the demand goes unresolved, the more pressure it generates. This is useful. It is also not a stable long-term arrangement, and you know it.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: the entity may activate The Fracture Line autonomously once per long rest, choosing the option it considers most appropriate. You feel the release before you understand what happened. The 3 Dominance cost applies regardless of who initiated.
7.narrative: The entity has found a use for its own frustration. It releases the tension when it judges the moment correct, through your body, without consultation. You cannot prevent it. You can, afterward, assess whether its judgment was better or worse than yours would have been.

increases.trigger: Activate The Fracture Line

decreases.trigger: Partially address the entity's original demand — not fully grant it, but acknowledge its legitimacy and offer something related
decreases.note: The tension decreases when the demand is taken seriously, even without being met.

development_paths.name: The Productive Wound
development_paths.requirement: Use The Fracture Line in 4 separate scenes, using each of the three options at least once. Partially address the entity's original demand at least once during this period.
development_paths.result: Qualifies for trial unlock — 'Trial: The Last Negotiation'.

hooks.text: The entity's original demand — the one from the Interior War, the one that started this — has become relevant to a situation you are currently navigating. Not as a threat, as a solution. Granting the demand would resolve the current problem cleanly. The entity has not pointed this out. It is waiting to see if you notice on your own. You have noticed.

The Hold option of the Fracture Line, used in a previous scene, created a zone of Dominance stability that has persisted beyond its stated duration. Something in the location's planar resonance is sustaining it. Other bonded individuals in the region are being drawn to it — it is, apparently, extraordinarily rare and valuable. The entity, when asked about this, uses a word in its own language that you translate, approximately, as landmark.

eidolon_powers.name: Trial: The Last Negotiation
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: The trial arrives when you have used every tool available to you — cooperation, tension, refusal, compliance — and the entity presents the question it has been building toward since the Binding: not what you will allow it to do, but what you believe you are. Together. The question is asked once, in the deepest part of a long rest, in a language that is half yours and half the entity's, and it does not repeat.

effects.mechanic: A single ordeal in five movements with no rest permitted between them. Movement 1: The History — review every Dominance threshold you have crossed and every significant choice you made involving the entity. Name three. No check. This cannot be skipped. Movement 2: The Entity's Account — the entity describes the same events from its perspective. Listen. Do not interrupt. No check. Movement 3: The Question — the entity asks what you are, together. You must answer in one sentence. No check, but the answer is permanent and recorded. Movement 4: The Test — Dominance rises to 8. Make a DC 17 Wisdom save to speak the answer you gave in Movement 3 aloud again, correctly, while the entity is at maximum presence. Movement 5: The Choice — accept fusion, reject it, or propose a third option. Only the first two unlock tier 4. The third option ends the trial without completion and cannot be reattempted.
effects.narrative: The last negotiation is not about terms. You have had that conversation. This is about whether you believe what you said in it. The entity will be at maximum presence when you repeat your answer. If the answer changes under that pressure, it was not your answer — it was what you wished your answer was. The trial is the difference between those two things.

skill_checks.success: Speak the answer correctly at Dominance 8. Proceed to Movement 5.
skill_checks.failure: The answer comes out altered — not wrong, not a lie, but changed in a way that the entity and you both register. Proceed to Movement 5 with the altered answer recorded. The tier 4 acquisition will reflect the difference.

eidolon_powers.name: The Unified Being
eidolon_powers.acquisition_condition: Complete the Last Negotiation having mastered both tier 3 powers and given your answer in Movement 3. The choice in Movement 5 determines which form the apex takes.

accept.label: Accept fusion — become something that is neither you nor the entity but contains both.
accept.consequence: Unlock The Unified Being in its merged form. The eidolon tree is complete. Dominance no longer functions as a meter — it becomes a permanent state at 5, fixed. You cannot lose control because the distinction between your control and the entity's has dissolved. You gain access to the full apex effects. The entity does not disappear. You do not disappear. Something new, that answers to both names, continues forward.
accept.permanent_effect: Dominance fixed at 5. All eidolon powers enhanced as listed. The merged identity is recorded permanently on the character sheet. You may still be affected by effects that target either humanoids or the entity's creature type — you are both, which is occasionally inconvenient and occasionally extraordinary.

reject.label: Reject fusion — remain separate, permanently and deliberately, at the cost of the deepest potential of the bond.
reject.consequence: The eidolon tree closes. All existing powers remain, frozen. Dominance maximum is permanently reduced to 6 — the entity cannot reach full presence, ever again. In exchange, you gain a singular permanent power: 'The Separate Self' — once per long rest, you may act for 1 scene as though the entity does not exist: no Dominance costs, no autonomous actions, no perceptual overlay. Just you, alone, for the duration. The entity does not leave. It waits. It has learned, from you, how to wait.
reject.permanent_effect: Eidolon powers locked. Dominance maximum 6. 'The Separate Self' added permanently. The choice is recorded on the character sheet under: What I Chose To Remain.

effects.mechanic: All eidolon powers are enhanced: power DCs increase by 2, damage dice increase by one size, and once per long rest you may enter The Full Expression — a state lasting up to 1 minute in which the entity is fully present and fully cooperative simultaneously. During The Full Expression: you gain all benefits of The Manifest Form, The Concordat, and one chosen tier 1 power simultaneously; Dominance is fixed at 5 for the duration and cannot be moved by any means; and you may take two actions on each of your turns, the second of which must be an eidolon power. At the end of The Full Expression, Dominance returns to its pre-activation level.
effects.narrative: The Full Expression is not a transformation. You do not become something else. You become, for one minute, completely what you are — the human parts and the entity's parts running in parallel at full capacity, neither suppressing the other, neither waiting for the other, a coordination so complete it looks from the outside like a single thing. It is not a single thing. It is two things that have learned, through years of argument and negotiation and refusal and concession, to move together without losing the difference between them. You come out of it correctly. You have always come out of it correctly. You have stopped being surprised by this and started being grateful, which is a significant change from where you started.

0.mechanic: Dominance 0: The Full Expression unavailable. Enhanced power bonuses reduced by 1. The entity is present but minimal.
0.narrative: The unified being at minimum presence is still more than either component was alone. But the coordination requires both to be present, and at 0 the entity is technically there and functionally elsewhere.

4.mechanic: Dominance 4: The Full Expression lasts the full minute. During it, the second action may be any action, not only eidolon powers — the entity contributes its capacity to whatever you are doing.
4.narrative: The middle ground is where the collaboration is most legible. Neither dominant, neither suppressed — two intelligences with different natures applying themselves to the same problem from different angles simultaneously.

7.mechanic: Dominance 7: The Full Expression can be activated as a bonus action instead of an action. The duration extends to 2 minutes. However, during the second minute, Dominance increases by 1 per round — the entity is running at full capacity and it costs. At the end of the second minute, make a DC 14 Wisdom save or the entity expresses one final autonomous action before the state ends.
7.narrative: At full presence the collaboration is effortless and expensive and the entity is very, very present, and the last few seconds of the second minute are the ones where you remember that effortless and controlled are not the same thing, and that this specific distinction is the one you have been working on since the first night, and that you have come a long way, and that there is still a way to go.

increases.trigger: The Full Expression's second minute
increases.note: Per round. The entity at full capacity is not free.

decreases.trigger: End The Full Expression voluntarily before the second minute, at a moment when continuing would have been advantageous
decreases.note: The unified being choosing restraint is different from the unformed bond choosing restraint. The entity understands what it costs now. It respects it differently.

hooks.text: The entity has a history. You knew this abstractly. You now know it specifically: something from that history has arrived, drawn by the Full Expression — by the signal of an entity at full cooperation inside a mortal body, which is apparently unusual enough to function as a beacon. What has arrived is not hostile. It is not friendly. It is the specific quality of something that knew the entity before you did, and is looking at you with the expression of someone who has complicated feelings about what the entity has become since then.

The answer you gave in Movement 3 of the Last Negotiation — the one sentence, the permanent record — has been heard by something beyond the entity. Not stolen, not eavesdropped: the answer was loud enough, at that level of honesty, to carry. Something has sent back a response, through a channel you did not know existed, in a language that is partly yours and partly the entity's and partly something older than both. The entity translates it. The translation is three words. They are not a threat, not an invitation, not a greeting. They are the beginning of a sentence. The rest of the sentence has not arrived yet.

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Eidolon Manifestation
suggested_use: You have just gained a new eidolon power and want to know how the entity first expresses it — through your body, your behavior, or the reaction of the world around you.
The Dominance Meter crosses a threshold for the first time and you want to understand what that shift feels like from the inside.
A scene ends ambiguously and you want the entity to decide what it leaves behind.

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Eidolon Minor Boons
suggested_use: The Eidolon Manifestation table sent you here.
You acted in accordance with the entity's nature — followed its input, honored a boundary it set, completed something it cared about — and want to know if the cooperation left something behind.
You successfully reduced Dominance through deliberate negotiation and want to know what the restraint earned.

results.mechanic: Gain advantage on your next Intelligence or Wisdom check. The entity offers its perspective without being asked.
results.narrative: The thought arrives already annotated. You did not reach for it — it was simply there, alongside yours, older and more certain, pointing at the same answer from a different direction.

results.mechanic: Until your next short rest, you have advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects. The entity has seen things that make these attempts seem small.
results.narrative: Something tries to reach into your mind and finds the room already occupied. It reconsiders.

results.mechanic: One NPC in the current location reacts to you with instinctive deference — not fear, not charm, simple recognition of something they cannot name. They are cooperative for this scene.
results.narrative: They look at you and something in their animal brain files you under a category that does not have a mortal name. They are not sure why they are helping. They do not question it.

results.mechanic: Recover 1d6 HP. The entity contributes something from its own reserves to repair what your body cannot manage alone.
results.narrative: The wound closes with a quality that is not quite natural — not magic exactly, more like the body remembering a more complete version of itself and briefly returning to it.

results.mechanic: You understand one language you do not know for the duration of a single conversation. The entity has encountered it before.
results.narrative: The words arrive pre-interpreted, the way things arrive when the entity is involved — not learned, simply present, as though you always knew and had merely forgotten.

results.mechanic: Reduce Dominance by 2. The entity withdraws slightly of its own accord — a courtesy, or a recalibration.
results.narrative: The pressure behind your thoughts eases without explanation. The entity has made a decision about the current level of its presence and quietly revised it downward. You do not ask why. You accept the space.

results.mechanic: Once this scene, you may ask the GM one yes/no question about the true nature of a person or object present. The entity answers through your perception, accurately.
results.narrative: The second layer flickers on briefly — unsolicited, precise, useful. The entity has noticed something it considers worth sharing. This is not always the case. Tonight it is.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 — the entity's contribution always has a cost

results.mechanic: The next time Dominance would increase this scene, it does not. The entity holds itself at its current level as a demonstration of restraint.
results.narrative: The moment passes — the kind of moment where the entity usually presses — and it does not press. It is making a point. You note it. The note is recorded in the ongoing conversation between you.
results.dominance_effect_note: next Dominance increase this scene is negated

results.mechanic: You cannot be teleported, dimensionally displaced, or moved without your consent until your next long rest. The entity has made itself into ballast.
results.narrative: Something roots you to the place you are standing with a weight that has nothing to do with your body. Whatever was going to move you recalculates and declines.

results.mechanic: Add 1d8 damage of the eidolon's type to one attack before the end of the scene. The entity lends its nature to the blow directly.
results.narrative: The strike lands with something extra — a quality that belongs to the entity's plane of origin, expressed briefly through your hands. Whatever it hit will remember the texture of it.

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Eidolon Minor Curses
suggested_use: The Eidolon Manifestation table sent you here.
You acted against the entity's expressed preferences, ignored its input, or pushed Dominance down through force rather than negotiation.
A scene ended with unresolved tension between you and the entity and you want to carry that tension forward.

results.mechanic: The entity offers an unsolicited observation at the worst possible moment this scene, spoken through you before you can stop it. The content is accurate. The timing is not yours.
results.narrative: You are in the middle of a sentence and a different sentence comes out — true, precise, and entirely the wrong thing to say in this moment. The entity does not have a concept of subtext. It is learning. It is not there yet.

results.mechanic: At the start of your next scene, Dominance increases by 1 without cause. The entity has been active while you were not.
results.narrative: You surface from sleep or stillness and the meter has moved. The entity was doing something in the space between your awareness. It does not explain itself.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 at the start of your next scene

results.mechanic: The second layer activates involuntarily for 1 scene. You perceive the planar residue of the current location whether you want to or not. Disadvantage on Concentration and social checks while it is active.
results.narrative: The filter fails and the room arrives in full — its history, its emotional residue, every significant thing that has happened in it pressing on your perception simultaneously. Conversation is difficult. The entity does not understand why you would want the layer off.

results.mechanic: The next NPC you interact with socially makes their check to detect something wrong about you with advantage. The entity's presence is briefly visible.
results.narrative: Something shifts in your eyes or your voice or the specific quality of your stillness, and the person across from you notices it before you can manage the impression. They do not have a word for what they saw. They will think about it later.

results.mechanic: Your next long rest restores only half normal HP. The entity was active during the rest in ways that prevented full recovery.
results.narrative: You wake having clearly been somewhere — or having had someone in you who was somewhere — and the body is not rested so much as occupied. The entity does not consider this a problem. You have different requirements.

results.mechanic: The entity refuses to cooperate with one specific eidolon power of your choice for this session. It has an objection it will not explain. The power is unavailable until the session ends.
results.narrative: You reach for the power and find the entity has moved to a different room and locked the door. It is present. It is simply not cooperative on this particular point, for reasons it considers self-evident and has declined to share.

results.mechanic: Until your next short rest, magical effects you produce have a 1-in-6 chance of expressing the eidolon's type of damage or energy instead of the intended type. The entity is bleeding into the workings.
results.narrative: The spell lands wrong — not the wrong target, not the wrong shape, just the wrong color, the wrong texture, the wrong smell. Whatever your eidolon is, it is currently louder than your intentions.

results.mechanic: If the entity has an outstanding demand from any trial or development path, it surfaces now — the entity presses it directly, and you must make a DC 12 Wisdom save or spend your next action addressing it in some way.
results.narrative: The unresolved thing has been waiting and now it is not waiting. You are in the middle of something else and the entity has decided that the middle of something else is precisely when this needs to be discussed.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 if the save is failed

results.mechanic: You use a word or phrase in conversation that you did not choose — the entity's language bleeding into yours. One NPC registers the anomaly. They will ask about it later.
results.narrative: The word comes out in something that is not quite any language you know, and you hear it as it leaves your mouth, and the person across from you hears it too, and the silence that follows has a specific quality.

results.mechanic: When you next enter a scene containing another bonded individual or planar entity, the entity reacts before you do — make a DC 13 Wisdom save or the entity's response (curiosity, hostility, recognition) expresses through your body before you can modulate it.
results.narrative: Something in the room is like it, or related to it, or known to it. The reaction is immediate and pre-verbal and your face is already doing something before your mind catches up to what triggered it.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 on a failed save

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Resonance Effects
suggested_use: The Eidolon Manifestation table sent you here.
A Dominance threshold was crossed and you want to understand what the shift has changed in how you interact with the world.
You used an eidolon power in an unusual way and want to know what the excess expressed.

results.mechanic: A physical detail appropriate to the eidolon's nature becomes more pronounced until your next long rest. Mortals who see it make a DC 11 Wisdom save or react with instinctive unease.
results.narrative: The mark the entity left at the Binding has become more itself today. You check it in the glass and understand that the negotiation about what you look like is ongoing, and today the entity's side is winning.

results.mechanic: Objects you touch for more than 1 minute retain a faint impression of the eidolon's nature for 24 hours. Creatures sensitive to planar energy detect this automatically.
results.narrative: You pick up a glass and set it down and it is briefly, faintly, wrong — the wrong temperature, the wrong resonance, carrying a trace of wherever the entity comes from. You are leaving fingerprints on the world in a new way.

results.mechanic: Your voice carries an additional register — very faint, below normal hearing but perceptible to those with planar sensitivity. Until your next long rest, Persuasion checks with ordinary mortals gain +1, but bonded individuals and planar entities automatically know what you are.
results.narrative: The entity is speaking alongside you without using words. The harmonic is too low for most people to consciously register. The ones who can hear it look at you differently.

results.mechanic: For this scene, the cost of all eidolon powers is reduced by 1 Dominance (minimum 0). The entity is closer to the surface than usual and the access is easier for it.
results.narrative: The distance between you and the entity has contracted. The powers flow differently — more readily, less resistance. You are aware that easier access runs in both directions.
results.dominance_effect_note: no change to Dominance, but power costs reduced this scene

results.mechanic: The entity experiences and expresses one of your emotions through your body without your direction — a laugh, a flinch, a moment of stillness that is too long. The emotion is real. The expression is slightly wrong. DC 12 Insight for observers to notice the quality of the wrongness.
results.narrative: You feel the thing and then you feel the entity feeling the thing through you, and the gap between the two feelings is very small and getting smaller, and you are not sure whether that is growth or erosion.

results.mechanic: During your next long rest, you and the entity share a dream that is drawn from the entity's history. You wake with one accurate piece of information about the entity's past or nature that it did not intentionally reveal.
results.narrative: The dream is not yours. The architecture is wrong, the light is wrong, the rules of cause and effect are slightly different. But you are in it and the entity is in it and when you wake you are carrying something it did not mean to give you.

results.mechanic: Once this scene, the entity overrides one of your reflexes with a better one — you may reroll any one d20 roll and take the higher result. You did not decide to do this. It decided for you.
results.narrative: Your body moves correctly before you choose to move it. The entity saw the situation more clearly and faster than you did and made the adjustment. The outcome is good. The process is something you need to think about.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 — the override always costs

results.mechanic: Dominance increases by 2 immediately, but all eidolon power DCs increase by 1 until your next long rest. The entity is more present and more capable simultaneously.
results.narrative: The dial moves without your hand on it and the powers sharpen in response. This is the relationship between Dominance and capability in its clearest expression: more of it means more of both. You are noting the pattern. The pattern is not neutral.
results.duration: until next long rest for the DC bonus

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Eidolon Significant Boons
suggested_use: The Eidolon Manifestation table sent you here.
You completed a development path requirement and want to know what the entity offers beyond the stated reward.
You survived a Dominance threshold crossing while maintaining your identity intact, and want to know if the endurance was noticed.

results.mechanic: Once before your next long rest, you may activate any one eidolon power at no Dominance cost. The entity covers the expense from its own reserves.
results.narrative: The entity offers this without explanation. It has decided, for reasons of its own, that this particular moment is worth investing in. You accept. You note the acceptance. The accounting between you continues.
results.dominance_effect_note: next eidolon power activation costs 0 Dominance

results.mechanic: Ask two yes/no questions about any person, place, or object the entity has encountered in its existence. The answers are accurate. The entity has been many places.
results.narrative: The library is vast and the entity opens two pages. You do not choose which pages — it chooses, based on what it considers relevant. The relevance is not always immediately clear.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, gain resistance to the eidolon's damage type and advantage on saves against effects from entities of the same planar origin. The entity protects what it inhabits.
results.narrative: The entity has made itself into armor, briefly and specifically. Things that come from where it comes from find you harder to reach than they expected.

results.mechanic: Once before your next long rest, after rolling a d20, you may reroll it and take either result. The entity agreed to this in advance. You are both aware of the terms.
results.narrative: You asked and it agreed and the agreement sits between you, ready to be spent. This is what cooperation looks like when it is functioning correctly. You try to remember this the next time it is not.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 when the reroll is used

results.mechanic: Reduce Dominance by 3. The entity withdraws to a level you both agree is appropriate. Something has been settled between you, at least for now.
results.narrative: The negotiation resolved. You do not always know exactly what was said, or what was conceded on either side, but the pressure is lower and the space is cleaner and the entity is present without being insistent. For now. The for now is doing a lot of work in that sentence.

results.mechanic: You become aware of one significant location within the current region that is meaningful to entities of the eidolon's nature — a site of power, a wound in the fabric, a door. The entity considers it relevant to your situation.
results.narrative: The knowledge arrives with the specific quality of something the entity has been holding back until the right moment. It has decided the right moment is now. You are not certain it is correct. You are going to find out.

results.mechanic: Until your next long rest, Dominance cannot exceed 7 regardless of activations or events. The entity has agreed to a ceiling. This agreement is temporary and it knows it.
results.narrative: The entity has placed a limit on itself for the duration. You do not know what it is getting in exchange for this concession. The exchange is happening at a level of the negotiation you cannot fully observe.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance capped at 7 until next long rest

results.mechanic: Roll on oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes. That entity type offers one specific, concrete, non-repeatable service or piece of information.
results.narrative: Something noticed the quality of what you have built with your eidolon — the arguments, the concessions, the specific texture of two wills learning to share a space. It has decided this is worth acknowledging.

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Eidolon Major Events
suggested_use: The Eidolon Manifestation table sent you here alongside oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes.
A significant threshold was crossed — Dominance at a new floor or ceiling — and you want to know what the world does in response.
A session ends with unresolved tension between you and the entity, and you want to seed the next one with consequences.

results.mechanic: An entity or faction from the eidolon's plane of origin becomes aware of the Binding. Roll oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes to determine who and what their disposition is.
results.narrative: The bond is visible from the other side. Something has noticed the light it makes and formed an opinion about it.

results.mechanic: An external entity — not your eidolon, something else — attempts to use your bond as a point of entry. You must make a DC 14 Charisma save or Dominance increases by 2 as the intrusion partially succeeds. Your eidolon is aware of this and is not pleased.
results.narrative: Something tried to use the door that the Binding opened. It did not ask permission. Your eidolon's reaction to this intrusion is the first time you have seen it be unambiguously on your side.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 2 on a failed save

results.mechanic: Another bonded individual enters your story. Roll oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes to determine the nature of their entity and their relationship to yours.
results.narrative: You recognize the quality of them before you understand what you are recognizing. The entity notices first. Its reaction tells you something about the history between the two entities that neither of them has chosen to share with you directly.

results.mechanic: A mortal organization — scholars, hunters, a religious order, a secret society — has become aware of your bond. They have not acted yet. They have a file. Roll 1d4: 1-2 they are hostile; 3 they are curious; 4 they want something only a bonded individual can provide.
results.narrative: Someone has been collecting the right kind of evidence, in the right order, and has arrived at the correct conclusion. The question is what they intend to do with it.

results.mechanic: The entity's past intersects with your present — an NPC, a location, or an object from the entity's history appears in your story. The entity has a reaction it cannot fully suppress.
results.narrative: The entity has a history that predates you by more than you can measure. Some of it is still present in the world. Today, some of it walked into the same room as you.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 — the entity's reaction costs

results.mechanic: Any outstanding demand from a trial or development path becomes urgent — the entity escalates from waiting to pressing. Until the demand is addressed, Dominance decreases from negotiation cost only half the normal amount.
results.narrative: The patience that defines the entity has a limit. You have found it. The demand is now in the foreground of every interaction between you, a constant low-frequency pressure that does not relent.
results.dominance_effect_note: no change to Dominance, but negotiation-based decreases are halved until demand is addressed

results.mechanic: You are led to or stumble upon a site of significant planar resonance — a location where the boundary between your plane and the eidolon's is unusually thin. Spending a long rest there counts as completing one oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes roll and reduces Dominance by 2.
results.narrative: The place feels like the entity feels — the same quality, the same temperature of wrongness. The entity is unusually quiet here, in the way that very familiar things produce silence rather than commentary.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance decreases by 2 if a long rest is taken at the site

results.mechanic: The next time Dominance would increase this session, it increases by 2 instead of 1. The entity has found a gap in your attention and widened it. Dominance cannot be reduced below its current level until after a long rest.
results.narrative: The entity found a moment when you were not managing the boundary and made use of it. Not maliciously — it does not think in those terms. It simply expanded into available space, the way all things do when the walls are down.
results.dominance_effect_note: next Dominance increase this session is doubled; Dominance locked until long rest

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Convergence Ascension
suggested_use: The Eidolon Manifestation table sent you here alongside oracle_table_eidolon_price_to_pay.
Dominance has reached 10 for the first time.
You have completed the tier 4 power and want to understand what the convergence has cost beyond the stated mechanic.

results.mechanic: One resonance effect from oracle_table_eidolon_resonance_effects becomes permanent and cannot be suppressed. The entity's presence in your body has stopped being temporary in this specific way.
results.narrative: The body has stopped negotiating on this point. The entity is simply present here now, in this particular detail, and the detail is yours to carry.

results.mechanic: Roll oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes. That entity type now has a standing claim on one future action of yours, unspecified, to be named when they choose. The entity was involved in making this agreement. You were not consulted.
results.narrative: A debt has been written at a level of the negotiation you do not have access to. The entity made an agreement on your behalf. It considered this reasonable. You are discovering that reasonable covers more ground than you thought.

results.mechanic: One aspect of your pre-Binding identity — a habit, a preference, a name you used, a relationship — becomes inaccessible. Not gone, not destroyed, simply no longer reachable from where you currently are. Dominance minimum increases to 2 permanently.
results.narrative: You reach for the thing and find it on the other side of a distance that has opened without your noticing. The entity did not take it. You moved away from it. The distinction is real and increasingly difficult to locate.

results.mechanic: Dominance Meter can no longer be reduced below 3 by any means short of a significant ritual or narrative act of deliberate separation.
results.narrative: The baseline has shifted. The entity is simply present at this level now — not pressing, not receding, occupying a floor that has become structural. What you were before was a lighter arrangement.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance cannot be reduced below 3 without a significant ritual

results.mechanic: Gain a permanent autonomous behavior tied to Dominance. At Dominance 7+, the entity may take one action per scene without your direction — not against you, but not necessarily what you would have chosen. DC 14 Wisdom save to delay it by 1 round.
results.narrative: It is not that you are losing control. It is that the entity has established a schedule. At a certain level of presence it simply acts, the way a tenant acts in a space they have occupied long enough to feel entitled to. You can slow it. You cannot stop it.
results.dominance_effect_note: no change to Dominance, but autonomous action triggers at 7+

results.mechanic: You qualify for The Unified Being if you do not already have it. Roll oracle_table_eidolon_price_to_pay twice — both costs apply. Dominance increases by 2 immediately.
results.narrative: This is not a reward. The entity does not give rewards. This is what happens when two things that have been sharing a space for long enough stop being two things in the way they used to be. The process is already underway. You are simply being informed.

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: The Price to Pay
suggested_use: The Convergence Ascension table sent you here.
You acquired a tier 3 or tier 4 power and want to know what it cost beyond the stated mechanic.
You allowed the entity to act autonomously and want the oracle to determine what that latitude extracted.

results.mechanic: The entity's name — or the name of what it is — is now known to something that did not know it before. They will make their interest apparent within three sessions.
results.narrative: Names are the oldest currency. The entity spent yours — or its own, which amounts to the same thing from the outside — without asking. It considers this a reasonable expenditure. You are still forming an opinion.

results.mechanic: One genuine relationship — not a tool, an actual connection — becomes strained. The other person has noticed something they cannot name and has begun creating space.
results.narrative: You did not do anything. The distance opened on its own, the way cold things push warmth away without trying. The entity does not understand why this is a problem. You understand exactly why and cannot fully explain it to the entity, which is itself part of the problem.

results.mechanic: Every location you spend more than 1 hour in this month retains a trace of the entity's presence for 1d6 days afterward. Planar-sensitive creatures will detect it. Mortals will feel uneasy without knowing why.
results.narrative: You are leaving more of yourself behind than before — or more of it, the entity's component. Every room you inhabit is briefly, faintly haunted by the quality of what you are. You are becoming a landmark in ways that were not part of the original arrangement.

results.mechanic: The entity invokes a past compact or negotiation in a way that is technically accurate but not what you intended. The outcome is not harmful but it is not yours. You must honor it — the entity will cite the specific terms if challenged.
results.narrative: The entity has found the gap in the language of a previous agreement and walked through it with the precise self-assurance of something that has been negotiating for centuries and knows exactly where the words bend. You read the original terms. You acknowledge, with some frustration, that it is not wrong.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 — the realization of your position costs something

results.mechanic: The Dominance level at which the entity may act autonomously decreases by 1 permanently — if it was 7, it is now 6. The entity has established a new normal.
results.narrative: The line moved. You did not move it intentionally. You are examining the sequence of events that led here and finding multiple moments where a different choice might have held it in place. The entity considers the new arrangement more accurate than the previous one.
results.dominance_effect_note: permanent reduction of autonomous action threshold by 1

results.mechanic: The entity develops a specific interest — an object, a person, a type of location — that it pursues through you at Dominance 6+. At that level, DC 14 Wisdom save to avoid moving toward the object of interest when it is within 60 feet.
results.narrative: The entity has wants that are distinct from needs and it has decided to express one. The want is not malicious. It is simply the entity being an entity with preferences, which is a thing you thought you were prepared for and are discovering you were not entirely.
results.dominance_effect_note: no change to Dominance, but compulsion triggers at 6+

results.mechanic: You gain access to a persistent, accurate memory from the entity's past — not your own experience, its experience. It arrives once per session, unbidden, complete and sensory, until you have done something with the information it contains.
results.narrative: The memory is not yours but you experience it from the inside. The entity did not choose to share it — you have simply gone deep enough into the bond that the border between its history and yours has become permeable in this specific direction.

results.mechanic: The entity reveals, or you discover, what it originally bound itself to you for — its actual purpose in the Binding, which may or may not align with what you understood the arrangement to be. Roll oracle_table_eidolon_entity_echoes for context. The revelation cannot be unfound.
results.narrative: The conversation you have been having for all this time had a subject you did not know about. The entity did not lie. It simply did not mention this part until now, which is a distinction that feels meaningful to it and is feeling increasingly technical to you.
results.dominance_effect_note: no change to Dominance — the cost is narrative, not mechanical, and it is real

eidolon_powers.name: Oracle: Entity Echoes
suggested_use: Another table sent you here to determine the nature or disposition of a planar entity, faction, or related power making contact.
You want to know who is paying attention to the Binding and what their interest is.
A major event has occurred involving the entity's nature and you want to seed the planar dimension of the response.

results.mechanic: An entity or faction from the eidolon's plane of origin — something that knew it before the Binding — has detected the bond. Their disposition depends on their relationship with your eidolon: roll 1d4 — 1 reverence, 2 hostility, 3 grief, 4 practical interest.
results.narrative: The entity had a life before you. The people — or things — from that life are beginning to notice where it ended up. Their feelings about this are complicated by the fact that it is inside a mortal, which is not a circumstance most of them would have predicted.

results.mechanic: An entity of opposed planar nature to your eidolon has become aware of the Binding and considers it a provocation. They will not act immediately. They are deciding on the appropriate response. The entity is aware of them and has become slightly more present as a result.
results.narrative: Your eidolon's nature and this entity's nature are in fundamental tension. The bond makes you a statement in an argument you did not know was ongoing. The entity has not explained the history. It has simply moved a little closer to the surface.
results.dominance_effect_note: Dominance increases by 1 — the entity's alertness costs

results.mechanic: A mortal or near-mortal scholar who specializes in eidolon bonds has taken an interest in you. They are not hostile. They want to study the Binding from the inside — with your cooperation, if possible. Their knowledge of your condition is uncomfortably accurate.
results.narrative: They have clearly done this before, or spoken to people who have. They use terminology you recognize from your own internal experience of the bond, which you have not shared with anyone. You are not sure how they know. They are not offering to explain.

results.mechanic: Someone whose Binding went wrong — whose entity took full control, or whose entity was destroyed, or who made the irrevocable choice under duress — crosses your path. Their condition is a warning or a lesson, depending on which direction you read it.
results.narrative: You look at them and see a possible version of yourself, which is either useful information or unbearable, depending on the day. They look at you and see something that still has options. The conversation between you is short and contains more than it says.

results.mechanic: Your eidolon was involved in an agreement made long before your Binding — with another entity, a faction, or a mortal bloodline. That agreement has a clause that is now active. The entity was aware of this. It did not mention it before now. It considers the timing appropriate.
results.narrative: The entity has been waiting for the right moment to explain a prior commitment. Its definition of the right moment and yours differ in ways that are becoming a theme in your relationship.

results.mechanic: Another entity of the same type as your eidolon makes contact — not through a bonded individual, directly. Its interest in you is based on what you represent: a member of its kind, housed in a mortal, navigating a situation that entities of its type do not usually navigate. It has opinions. It has advice. The advice may not be in your interest.
results.narrative: The entity's kind have a perspective on Bindings that differs from yours. From where they stand, the arrangement looks different. The advice is given with genuine intent and the intent is not entirely aligned with your survival as a distinct self.

results.mechanic: You learn something true about why the entity chose you specifically — not mortals in general, you. The information may reframe your understanding of the Binding's origins. Roll 1d4: 1 it was an accident; 2 it was deliberate and you were selected; 3 you summoned it without knowing you were summoning it; 4 it has been with you longer than the Binding — you simply did not know.
results.narrative: The origin story you have been carrying may not be the accurate one. The entity has a version that differs from yours in at least one significant detail. It has been waiting until you were ready for the accurate version. You are not sure you agree about the readiness.

results.mechanic: Something that predates the category your eidolon belongs to has become aware of the Binding. It does not communicate through conventional means. Its interest is impossible to read as either friendly or hostile — it is simply there, attending. The entity, when pressed, uses a word in its own language that translates approximately as: witness.
results.narrative: The entity is old. What is now attending you is older than old in a way that makes the entity seem recent. It is watching the Binding with the specific quality of something that has seen many things and is deciding whether this one is interesting. You will not know its verdict for some time.
